verses.text: Sawuli amaze gupfa, Dawidi aragaruka avuye kunesha Abamaleki aca aguma i Zikulagi imisi ibiri.
Ku musi ugira gatatu umuntu umwe araza avuye mu ngabo za Sawuli, yitabaguriyeko impuzu yisuriyeko ivu mu mutwe. Ashitse aho Dawidi ari, aramwunamira ashitsa umutwe hasi mu kumuha icubahiro.
Dawidi aramubaza ati: “Uvuye he?” Aramwishura ati: “Ncitse kw’icumu mva aho Abisirayeli bari bacumbitse.”
Dawidi aramubaza ati: “Vyagenze gute? Mbarira.” Aramwishura ati: “Ingabo z’Abisirayeli zahunze ku rugamba. Benshi bapfuye. Na Sawuli n’umuhungu wiwe Yonatani bapfuye.”
Maze Dawidi abwira wa musore amuzaniye inkuru ati: “Ni igiki cakumenyesheje ko Sawuli n’umuhungu wiwe Yonatani bapfuye?”
Wa musore ati: “Nari ku musozi Gilibowa, maze mbona Sawuli yishimikije icumu ryiwe, kandi azigirijwe n’imikogote n’abagendera ku mafarasi.
Ahindukiye arambona, arampamagara, nanje ndamwishura nti: ‘Nogukorera iki?’
Arambaza ati: ‘Uri nde?’ Ndamwishura nti: ‘Ndi Umwamaleki.’
Arambwira ati: ‘Egera hano unyice! Nta co ngisigaje, naho nkiri muzima.’
Nuko ndamwegera ndamuhohosha, kuko nabonye ko atari gukira. Maze nca mfata urugori rwari ku mutwe wiwe n’ikidede cari ku kuboko kwiwe nca ndabizanira databuja hano.”
Nuko Dawidi n’abo bari kumwe bitaburirako impuzu.
Bararira baraboroga barisonzesha gushika ku mugoroba ku bwa Sawuli n’umuhungu wiwe Yonatani, n’ingabo zose z’ Uhoraho n’ab’inzu ya Isirayeli bose, kuko bishwe n’inkota.
Dawidi abwira wa musore yamuzaniye inkuru ati: “Uturuka he?” Arishura ati: “Ndi umuhungu w’inyambukira, Umwamaleki.”
Dawidi aramubaza ati: “Ni kuki watinyutse kwica uwo Uhoraho yarobanuje amavuta?”
Maze Dawidi ahamagara umwe mu bantu biwe ati: “Genda umwice!” Nuko aragenda aramwica.
Kuko Dawidi yari yamubwiye ati: “Amaraso yawe aje ku gatwe kawe. Akanwa kawe ni ko kakwagirije igihe wivugira uti: ‘Nishe uwo Uhoraho yarobanuje amavuta.’ ”
Nuko Dawidi acura intimba ku bwa Sawuli n’umuhungu wiwe Yonatani,
aca ategeka abantu b’i Buyuda ngo bigishwe iyo ndirimbo yo gucura intimba y’umuheto (kandi yanditse mu gitabu ca Yashari). Aravuga ati:
“Iteka n’umunezero vyawe, yewe Isirayeli, birambaraye ku misozi. Ese ukungene abahizi bawe bapfuye!
Ntimubibwire ab’i Gati, ntimuvyamamaze mu mabarabara y’i Ashikeloni, kugira ngo abakobwa b’Abafilisitiya ntibanezerwe, kugira ngo abakobwa b’izo ntakebwa ntibahimbarwe.

Yemwe misozi y’i Gilibowa, ntimukongere kugira urume canke imvura, canke ngo mugire imirima ishobora kwera ingano. Kuko kuri mwebwe ari ho inkinzo z’abahizi zahumaniye. Inkinzo ya Sawuli ntizosubira gusigwa amavuta.
Amaraso adasesetse, abahizi batarashwe, umuheto wa Yonatani ntiwigera usubira inyuma, kandi n’inkota ya Sawuli ntiyagaruka idakoze igikorwa cayo.
Sawuli na Yonatani bakiriho barakundwa cane kandi no mu rupfu ntibatandukanye. Banyaruka kurusha inkona, bari bakomeye kurusha intambwe.
Yemwe bakobwa ba Isirayeli, nimuririre Sawuli, yabambika impuzu nziza z’igiciro, yashariza impuzu zanyu n’ibisharizo vy’inzahabu.
Ese ukuntu abahizi baguye mu ntambara! Yonatani umuvyimba wiwe urambaraye ku misozi.
Ndababaye ku bwawe, Yonatani muvukanyi; wari uw’igiciro kuri jewe. Urukundo wankunda rwari igitangaza, rwari igitangaza kurusha urw’abagore.
Ewe kuntu abahizi baguye ku rugamba! Ibigwanisho vy’intambara vyasambuwe!”

headings.text: Dawidi acura intimba ku bwa Sawuli na Yonatani

verses.text: Inyuma y’ivyo, Dawidi asiguza Uhoraho . Amubaza ati: “Nduge nje mu gisagara kimwe c’i Buyuda?” Uhoraho aramwishura ati: “Duga.” Dawidi arabaza ati: “Nduze noshikira mu gisagara ikihe?” Uhoraho aramwishura ati: “Heburoni.”
Nuko Dawidi araduga ajana n’abagore biwe babiri, Ahinowamu w’i Yezireyeli na Abigayili, umupfakazi wa Nabali w’i Karumeli.
Dawidi ajana kandi na ba bantu bari kumwe na we bose, umwe wese n’umuryango wiwe, baja kuba i Heburoni no mu bisagara vyaho.
Maze abantu b’i Buyuda baza i Heburoni baca barobanuza amavuta Dawidi ngo abe umwami w’umuryango wa Yuda. Maze Dawidi bamubwiye ko abantu b’i Yabeshi Gileyadi ari bo bahamvye Sawuli,
arungika intumwa ku bantu b’i Yabeshi Gileyadi zibabwira ziti: “ Uhoraho abahezagire kuko mwerekanye urukundo mwakunda Sawuli shobuja mu kumuhambana iteka.
Uhoraho abagirire neza abereke n’ubwizigirwa bwiwe, kandi nanje nyene ni ko nzobagirira kuko mwakoze mutyo.
Ubu rero, mukomere mube abagabo, kuko Sawuli shobuja yapfuye, ariko kandi ab’inzu ya Yuda bamaze kunyimikisha amavuta kugira ngo mbe umwami wabo.”
Bikiri gutyo, Abuneri mwene Neri, umukuru w’ingabo za Sawuli, yari yafashe Ishibosheti mwene Sawuli amutwara i Mahanayimu.
Ashitseyo, amugira umwami w’intara za Gileyadi, Ashuri, Yezireyeli, Efurayimu, Benyamini na Isirayeli yose.
Ishibosheti mwene Sawuli yari amaze imyaka mirongo ine igihe yaba umwami w’Abisirayeli, atwara imyaka ibiri. Ariko, umuryango wa Yuda wowo, uguma uyoboka Dawidi.
Imyaka yose Dawidi yamaze ari umwami i Heburoni aganza inzu ya Yuda yabaye indwi n’amezi atandatu.
Abuneri mwene Neri, hamwe n’ingabo za Ishibosheti mwene Sawuli, bava i Mahanayimu baja i Gibeyoni.
Yowabu mwene Zeruwiya n’ingabo za Dawidi na bo baragenda baja guhura na bo, bahurira ku kidengeri c’i Gibeyoni. Ingabo zimwe zija ku ruhande rumwe rw’ico kidengeri izindi zija ku rundi ruhande.
Maze Abuneri abwira Yowabu ati: “Reka dutore imisore ihaguruke igwane imbere yacu.” Yowabu aravuga ati: “Egome, tubigire uko.”
Nuko bava hasi barabaharura, abagabo cumi na babiri baserukira Ababenyamini na Ishibosheti mwene Sawuli, hamwe n’abandi icumi na babiri ku ruhande rw’abaserukira Dawidi.
Maze umuntu wese aca asumira umutwe w’uwo ku rundi ruhande amuzibura inkota mu rubavu, bose bagwa hasi aho nyene bapfira rimwe. Baca bita aho hantu Helukati Hazurimu h’i Gibeyoni.
Kuva uwo musi haca haba intambara ikomeye, Abuneri n’Abisirayeli baratsindwa cane n’ingabo za Dawidi.
Abahungu batatu ba Zeruwiya: Yowabu, Abishayi na Asaheli ni ho bari. Uwo Asaheli mu kwiruka yaranyaruka cane kurya kw’ingeregere.
Yiruka kuri Abuneri, kandi yanka kumuva inyuma ngo aje i buryo canke i bumoso.
Abuneri akebutse inyuma aramubaza ati: “Ni wewe ga Asaheli?” Arishura ati: “Ni jewe.”
Nuko Abuneri aramubwira ati: “Hindukirira i buryo canke i bumoso; maze ufate umwe muri barya basore umushikure ibigwanisho vyiwe.” Ariko Asaheli ntiyahagarika kumukurikira.
Abuneri yongera kubwira Asaheli ati: “Reka kwiruka unkurikira, ntibitume ndakwica. Noheza ngashobora nte gusubira kuraba mu maso ha mukuru wawe Yowabu?”
Ariko Asaheli aranka aguma amukurikira; nuko Abuneri amucumita icumu mu nda riseruka mu mugongo. Aca agwa ngaho arapfa. Umuntu wese yashika aho Asaheli yaguye yaca ahagarara.
Nuko Yowabu na Abishayi bakurikira Abuneri, izuba rirenga bashitse ku musozi wa Ama, hafi y’i Giya mu nzira ija mu bugaragwa bw’i Gibeyoni.
Maze abo mu ngabo za Abuneri bo mu muryango wa Benyamini bifatanya na Abuneri. Bigira akagwi bahagarara ku gatwe k’umusozi.
Abuneri ahamagara Yowabu ati: “Mbega tuzokwama tuzibagurana inkota igihe cose? Ntubona ko ibi bizotuzanira kwamana inzigo? Urindiriye iki kubuza abantu bawe gukurikira abavukanyi babo?”
Yowabu aramwishura ati: “Ndahiye uguhoraho kw’Imana, iyo utagira ico uvuga, twari gushishikara kubakurikira mbere n’ijoro ryose.”
Maze Yowabu avuza inzamba, abantu bose barahagarara; ntibasubira gukurikira Abisirayeli, canke ngo basubire kugwana.
Abuneri n’abantu biwe bagenda ijoro ryose baca mu kiyaya Araba. Bajabuka Yorodani, babandanya no mu gitondo cose maze bashika i Mahanayimu.
Nuko Yowabu asubira inyuma areka gukurikirana Abuneri aca akoranya abantu bose ngo arabe abo yabuze. Asanga mu bantu ba Dawidi habuze cumi n’icenda adashizemwo Asaheli.
Ariko abantu ba Dawidi bari bishe Ababenyamini amajana atatu na mirongo itandatu bari kumwe na Abuneri.
Batwara Asaheli bamuhamba mu mva ya se yari i Betelehemu. Hanyuma Yowabu n’ingabo ziwe bagenda ijoro ryose bashika i Heburoni umutwenzi utambitse.

headings.text: Intambara yabaye hagati y’inzu ya Dawidi n’inzu ya Sawuli

verses.text: Iyo yari intango y’intambara yamaze igihe kirekire hagati y’abashigikiye ingoma ya Dawidi, n’abakomeje gushigikira ingoma ya Sawuli. Mu bihe vyakurikiye, Dawidi yakomeje kuguma akomera, ariko abo mu muryango wa Sawuli bobo baguma baba abanyantegenke.
Aba ni bo bahungu Dawidi yavyariye i Heburoni: imfura yiwe ni Amunoni, nyina yari Ahinowamu w’i Yezireyeli;
uwa kabiri ni Kileyabu, nyina yari Abigayili umupfakazi wa Nabali w’i Karumeli; uwa gatatu ni Abusalomu, nyina yari Mayaka umukobwa wa Talumayi umwami w’i Geshuri;
uwa kane ni Adoniya, nyina yari Hagiti; uwa gatanu ni Shefatiya, nyina yari Abitali;
n’uwa gatandatu, Itureyamu, uwo yavyaranye n’umugore wiwe Egula. Abo ni bo Dawidi yavyariye i Heburoni.
Muri ico gihe c’intambara hagati y’abagishigikiye ingoma ya Sawuli n’abashigikiye ingoma ya Dawidi, Abuneri agira ububasha bukomeye mu bari ku ruhande rwa Sawuli.
Sawuli yari afise incoreke yitwa Rizipa. Umusi umwe Ishibosheti yagiriza Abuneri, amubwira ati: “Ni kuki wubahuka kuryamana na Rizipa incoreke ya data, umukobwa wa Ayiya?”

Abuneri aca ashavuzwa cane n’uko Ishibosheti amwagirije, maze amwishura ati: “Mbega jewe ndi umutwe w’imbwa utembagaza uko wishakiye ku ruhande rw’Abayuda? Gushika uwu musi nabaye umwizigirwa mu nzu ya so Sawuli no mu muryango wiwe n’abagenzi biwe. Sinagutanze mu maboko ya Dawidi. Ariko uwu musi unyagirije icaha hamwe n’uwu mugore!
Imana ize ibimpore, kandi birushirije, nintashitsa kuri Dawidi ivyo Uhoraho yamusezeraniye,
ngiye gukura ingoma mu nzu ya Sawuli ndayihe Dawidi aganze Abisirayeli n’Abayuda kuva i Dani gushika i Berisheba.”
Ishibosheti ntiyubahutse kugira irindi jambo abwira Abuneri, kuko yamutinya.
Maze Abuneri atuma intumwa kuri Dawidi ati: “Mbega igihugu cose si rwawe? Emera tugiriranire isezerano, hanyuma nce ndagufasha kwigarurira Isirayeli yose.”
Dawidi aravuga ati: “Ni vyiza. Ndemeye kugiriranira isezerano nawe. Mugabo, ntuze wigere uza ngo tubonane amaso mu yandi utanzaniye Mikali umukobwa wa Sawuli.”
Maze Dawidi atuma intumwa kuri Ishibosheti mwene Sawuli ati: “Mpa umugore wanje Mikali, uwo nakoye udukoba ijana tuvuye ku bitsinagabo vy’Abafilisitiya.”
Nuko Ishibosheti atanga amategeko ko baja kumukura ku mugabo wiwe Palutiyeli mwene Layishi.
Ariko umugabo wiwe ajana na we, agenda araririra inyuma yiwe inzira yose gushika i Bahurimu. Maze Abuneri amubwira ati: “Subira i muhira!” Nuko aca asubira iwe.
Muri ico gihe, Abuneri aganira n’abakuru bo mu Bisirayeli ati: “Haheze igihe mwipfuza ko Dawidi yobabera umwami.

Ubu rero nimubishitse! Kuko Uhoraho yasezeraniye Dawidi ati: ‘Nzotabara abantu banje b’Abisirayeli nkoresheje umusavyi wanje Dawidi ndabakure mu maboko y’Abafilisitiya no mu maboko y’abansi babo bose.’ ”
Abuneri avugana kandi n’Ababenyamini we ubwiwe. Maze aja i Heburoni kubwira Dawidi ivyo Abisirayeli bose n’ab’inzu ya Benyamini bagomba gukora.
Igihe Abuneri yashika kwa Dawidi i Heburoni, ari kumwe n’abantu biwe mirongo ibiri, Dawidi yamuteguriye amazimano hamwe n’abo bantu biwe.

Nuko Abuneri abwira Dawidi ati: “Reka ngende nihuta nkoranye Abisirayeli bose ku bwa databuja umwami, kugira ngo mugiriranire isezerano na bo, no kugira ngo uganze aho hose umutima wawe ushaka.” Nuko Dawidi asezera Abuneri agenda amahoro.

Haheze akanya abantu ba Dawidi na Yowabu baratahuka bavuye ku rugamba baza bazanye ivyo basahuye vyinshi. Ariko Abuneri ntiyari akiri kumwe na Dawidi i Heburoni, kuko Dawidi yari yamusezeye kandi yagiye amahoro.
Yowabu n’abasoda bari kumwe na we bashitse, bamubwira ko Abuneri mwene Neri yaje kubonana n’umwami kandi ko umwami yamurungitse akagenda amahoro.
Nuko Yowabu aja kuraba umwami aramubwira ati: “Wakoze ibiki? Abuneri yaje, hanyuma umurungika amahoro, aragenda?
Wewe urazi Abuneri mwene Neri. Nta kindi cari kimuzanye atari ukukubesha no gusuma amakuru kugira ngo amenye inzira zawe zose n’ivyo uriko urakora vyose.”
Yowabu aca avana na Dawidi, atuma intumwa kuri Abuneri, bamugarurira kw’iriba ry’i Sira. Ariko Dawidi ntiyabimenya.

Maze Abuneri agarutse i Heburoni, Yowabu amutwara ku ruhande inyuma y’urugi rw’igisagara nk’uwugomba kumwihereranya. Mu ntumbero yo guhora amaraso ya murumunawe Asaheli, Yowabu aca amucumita inkota mu nda, aca arapfa.
Mu nyuma Dawidi avyumvise, aca avuga ati: “Jewe n’ubwami bwanje turera imbere y’ Uhoraho ku bw’ayo maraso ya Abuneri mwene Neri.

Amaraso yiwe aze aje ku mutwe wa Yowabu no ku mutwe w’inzu ya se yose! Mu nzu ya Yowabu ntihaze higere habura umunyamibembe canke uwugwaye ibinyoro canke uwugendera ku kibando canke uwicwa n’inkota canke utagira ico arya.”
(Yowabu n’uwo bavukana Abishayi bishe Abuneri kuko yari yarishe murumuna wabo Asaheli mu ntambara y’i Gibeyoni.)
Nuko Dawidi abwira Yowabu n’abantu bose bari kumwe na we ati: “Nimwitabagurireko impuzu mwambare amagunira muririre Abuneri.” Umwami Dawidi ubwiwe agendera inyuma y’umuvyimba.
Bahamba Abuneri i Heburoni, kandi umwami aborogera cane ku mva ya Abuneri. N’abantu bose bararira.
Umwami aririmba iyi ndirimbo yo gucura intimba ati: “Mbega Abuneri yari akwiye gupfa nk’uko abagarariji bapfa?
Amaboko yawe ntiyari aboshwe, n’amaguru yawe ntiyagira iminyororo. Yapfuye nk’uko umuntu agwa imbere y’abanyakibi.” Kandi n’abantu bose baramuririra.

Nuko baraza bose binginga Dawidi ngo agire ico arya kuko hari hakiri ku murango; ariko Dawidi ararahira, avuga ati: “Imana irakabimpanira, mbere birushirije, ninagira ico ntamira, waba umukate canke ikindi cose, izuba ritararenga!”
Abantu bose baravyumva kandi birabahimbara; mbere ikintu cose umwami yakora carabahimbara.
Nuko kuri uwo musi abantu bose n’Abisirayeli bamenya ko umwami ata ruhara yagize mu kwicwa kwa Abuneri mwene Neri.
Maze umwami abwira abantu biwe ati: “Mbega ntimubona ko uwu musi mu Bisirayeli hapfuye umugabisha, umuntu ahambaye?
Kandi uwu musi, naho ndi uwimikishijwe amavuta, ndi umunyantegenke, kandi aba bahungu ba Zeruwiya bandusha inkomezi. Uhoraho aze yishure uwakoze ibi, ibihuye n’ikibi yakoze!”

headings.text: Abuneri ava kuri Ishibosheti yifatanya na Dawidi

verses.text: Ishibosheti mwene Sawuli yumvise ko Abuneri yapfiriye i Heburoni, aca aracika intege, kandi Abisirayeli bose bahagarika imitima.

Uwo mwene Sawuli yari afise abagabo babiri bari abakuru mu ngabo. Umwe yitwa Bayana uwundi na we yari Rekabu; bari bene Rimoni w’i Beroti wo mu muryango wa Benyamini. I Beroti ni ahantu hari hahinduwe igice ca Benyamini,
kuko abantu b’i Beroti bahungiye i Gitayimu bakabayo nk’inyambukira gushika n’uwu musi.

(Yonatani mwene Sawuli yari afise umuhungu yari yaramugaye amaguru yose. Yari amaze imyaka itanu igihe inkuru za Sawuli na Yonatani zivuye i Yezireyeli zashika. Umurezi wiwe aramufata aramuhungana, ariko uwo mukobwa kuko yariko arihuta cane ngo ahunge, aramukorokana, maze aca aba ikimuga. Uwo muhungu yitwa Mefibosheti.)
Umusi umwe Rekabu na Bayana, bene Rimoni Umuberoti, bagenda kwa Ishibosheti, bashikayo ari mu ndugumba yo ku murango na we yariko araruhuka mu gihe c’umurango.
Basanga umusanzi w’inzu yari yamye agosora ingano, arasinziriye. Baca barasoboka baramurengana binjira mu nzu haruguru. Maze Rekabu na Bayana bacumita umwami mu nda baca barahunga.

Bari binjiye mu nzu bamusanga yiryamiye ku buriri bwiwe mu cumba ciwe co kuryamamwo. Bamaze kumucumita bakamwica, baciye bamuca umutwe, hanyuma bahunga bawutwaye, bagenda ijoro ryose bajanye inzira ica mu kiyaya citwa Araba.

Bashitse i Heburoni bereka Dawidi umutwe wa Ishibosheti, babwira umwami bati: “Ng’uwu umutwe wa Ishibosheti mwene Sawuli, umwansi wawe, yagerageje kukwica. Uyu musi Uhoraho araguhoye mwami nyeningoma ku bwa Sawuli n’uruvyaro rwiwe.”
Dawidi yishura Rekabu n’uwo bavukana Bayana, bene Rimoni Umuberoti ati: “Ndahiye uguhoraho kw’ Uhoraho , yantabaye mu ngorane zose,
igihe haza umuntu akambwira ngo: ‘Sawuli yapfuye,’ mu kwiyumvira ko anzaniye inkuru nziza, naciye ndamufata ndamwicira i Zikulagi. Iyo ni yo mpembo namuhaye kubera iyo nkuru yari anzaniye!

None ntibirushiriza nimba abantu b’inkozi z’ikibi bafashe umuntu atariko urubanza, bakamwicira mu nzu yiwe no mu buriri bwiwe? Mbega sinkwiye kubahanira amaraso yiwe amaboko yanyu yavishije no kubakura kw’isi!”

Nuko Dawidi aha itegeko abantu biwe, maze barabica. Babaca ibikonjo vyompi n’ibirenge vyompi, baca bamanika imivyimba yabo ku kidengeri c’i Heburoni. Ariko, umutwe wa Ishibosheti wowo bawuhamba mu mva ya Abuneri yari i Heburoni.
Imiryango yose y’Abisirayeli iragenda, isanga Dawidi i Heburoni, iramubwira iti: “Twebwe turi umubiri wawe n’amaraso yawe.
Kandi kera, igihe Sawuli yari akiri umwami wacu, ni wewe warongora Abisirayeli mu ntambara. Kandi Uhoraho yarakubwiye ati: ‘Uzoba umwungere w’abantu banje b’Abisirayeli, kandi uzoba umutware wabo.’ ”
Abakuru bose b’Abisirayeli baja kuraba umwami Dawidi i Heburoni, aca agirana na bo isezerano aho nyene i Heburoni imbere y’ Uhoraho , na bo baca bamurobanuza amavuta ngo abe umwami w’Abisirayeli.
Dawidi yari afise imyaka mirongo itatu igihe yaba umwami, aca amara ku ngoma imyaka mirongo ine.
I Heburoni yahamaze imyaka indwi n’amezi atandatu, ari umwami w’umuryango wa Yuda gusa, i Yerusalemu na ho ahamara iyindi myaka mirongo itatu n’itatu aganza Abisirayeli bose.

Umwami n’ingabo ziwe baja i Yerusalemu gutera Abayebusi, ari bo bamye bahaba kuva kera. Abayebusi babwira Dawidi bati: “Ntuzoshobora kwinjira ngaha; kuko n’aho boba impumyi n’ibimuga bokwirukana.” Abayebusi biyumvira bati “Dawidi ntazoshobora gushika hano.”
Ariko Dawidi yigarurira igice c’ahitwa Siyoni hazitijwe impome zikomeye, ari ho haciye hitwa Igisagara ca Dawidi.

Kuri uwo musi, Dawidi abwira ingabo ziwe ati: “Ndanka ivyo bimuga n’izo mpumyi ari bo Bayebusi. Uwushaka kubanesha akwiye guca mu mugende w’amazi kugira ngo abashikire.” Aho ni ho havuye imvugo ivuga ngo: “Impumyi n’ibimuga ntibazokwigera binjira mu kirimba c’umwami.”

Nuko Dawidi aba aho hantu hazitijwe impome zikomeye, aca ahita Igisagara ca Dawidi. Aca yagura ico gisagara mu kwubaka izindi nyubakwa zo kuhakingira, uhereye ku musezero w’ahitwa Milo ukaja inyuma n’imbere.
Maze Dawidi arushaho kuba uwuhambaye, kuko Uhoraho Imana Mushoboravyose yari kumwe na we.
Maze, Hiramu umwami w’i Tiro arungika intumwa kuri Dawidi, azirungikana n’ibiti vy’amasederi n’ababaji n’abahinga mu kwubakisha amabuye, maze bubakira Dawidi ikirimba.
Maze Dawidi aca amenya ko Uhoraho yemeje ko ari we mwami w’Abisirayeli bose kandi ko yashize hejuru ubwami bwiwe kubera abantu biwe b’Abisirayeli.
Amaze kuva i Heburoni akaja i Yerusalemu, Dawidi arongora izindi ncoreke n’abandi bagore, avyara abandi bahungu n’abakobwa.
Aya ni yo mazina y’abana yavyariye i Yerusalemu: Shamuwa, Shobabu, Natani, Salomo,
Ibuhari, Elishuwa, Nefegi, Yafiya,
Elishama, Eliyada na Elifeleti.
Abafilisitiya bumvise ko Dawidi yasizwe amavuta ngo abe umwami w’Abisirayeli, baraduga n’inkomezi zabo zose bagiye kumurondera ngo bamufate; ariko Dawidi avyumvise aca aja kwinyegeza mu kinyegero.
Maze Abafilisitiya barashika bakwiragira mu kiyaya c’i Refayimu.
Nuko Dawidi asiguza Uhoraho ati: “Nduge nje gutera Abafilisitiya? Urabampa mu maboko yanje?” Uhoraho aramwishura ati: “Genda, nzobatanga nyene mu maboko yawe.”

Nuko Dawidi agenda i Bayali-Perazimu, arabagwanya arabanesha. Maze aravuga ati: “ Uhoraho yansaturiye inzira imbere y’abansi banje nk’uko amazi asenyura urugomero.” Aho hantu haca hitwa Bayali-Perazimu.
Abafilisitiya bari batayeho ibigirwamana vyabo, maze Dawidi n’abantu biwe baraza barabitwara.
Ikindi gihe Abafilisitiya bongera kuduga bakwiragira mu kiyaya cose c’i Refayimu.
Nuko Dawidi abaza Uhoraho ico yokora, na we aramwishura ati: “Ntubatere ubaturutse imbere, ariko ubazunguruke ubatere uturutse inyuma aharabana na biriya biti vyitwa popula.
Niwumva imirindi mu bushorishori bw’ivyo biti, uce unyaruka, kuko ico kizoba ari ikimenyetso co kukubwira ko Uhoraho agiye imbere yanyu mu gutera ingabo z’Abafilisitiya.”
Nuko Dawidi akora nk’uko Uhoraho yamutegetse, aca atsinda Abafilisitiya agenda arabica kuva i Geba gushika i Gezeri.
Dawidi asubira kwegeranya ingabo zigizwe n’abahizi b’Abisirayeli, bashika ibihumbi mirongo itatu.

Ubwiwe n’ingabo ziwe zose baragenda baja i Bayala h’i Buyuda kugira ngo bakureyo isandugu y’Imana, yitirirwa rya Zina, ari ryo zina ry’ Uhoraho Mushoboravyose, avyagiye hagati y’abakerubi bari kuri iyo sandugu.
Bashira ya sandugu y’Imana ku mukogote mushasha bayitwara bayikuye mu nzu kwa Abinadabu yari hejuru ku musozi. Uza na Ahiyo bene Abinadabu, ni bo bayobora inka zikwega uwo mukogote mushasha
utwaye iyo Sandugu y’Imana, kandi Ahiyo ni we yayigendera imbere.
Dawidi n’Abisirayeli bose bariko bariginagura imbere y’ Uhoraho , baririmba bavuza inanga, amakembe, udushako tw’ingoma n’ibindi bicurarangisho.
Bashitse ku mbuga yo kugosorerako ya Nakoni, Uza agorora ukuboko afata iyo sandugu y’Imana ngo ntihenuke, kuko impfizi zikwega uwo mukogote zari zitsitaye.
Maze, Uhoraho ashavurira cane Uza kuko akoze ibitari vyo. Nuko Imana iramukubita aca arapfa, agwa ngaho nyene i ruhande y’isandugu y’Imana.
Maze Dawidi arashavura kuko Uhoraho yarakiye Uza. Aca yita aho hantu Perezi-Uza, bisigura “gushavurira Uza”, kandi ni ko hacitwa kugeza n’uno musi.
Dawidi aca atinya Uhoraho kuri uwo musi, maze arabaza ati: “Mbega Isandugu y’ Uhoraho yoza iwanje gute?”
Ntiyemera gutwara Isandugu y’ Uhoraho ngo ibe aho asanzwe aba mu Gisagara ca Dawidi, ariko aca ayikebereza mu nzu kwa Obedi-Edomu w’i Gati.
Isandugu y’ Uhoraho iguma mu nzu kwa Obedi-Edomu w’i Gati kumara amezi atatu, kandi Uhoraho aramuhezagira hamwe n’abo mu nzu yiwe bose.

Maze babarira umwami Dawidi bati: “ Uhoraho yarahezagiye abo mu nzu kwa Obedi-Edomu n’ivyo atunze vyose, kubera ya Sandugu y’ Uhoraho .” Nuko Dawidi aramanuka aja kudugana iyo Sandugu y’Imana ayikura mu nzu kwa Obedi-Edomu ayijana mu Gisagara ca Dawidi bari mu munezero mwinshi.
Abareruye iyo Sandugu y’ Uhoraho bamaze kugira intambuko zitandatu, yaca atanga ikimazi c’ishuri n’inyana ivyibushe.
Dawidi yari yambaye efodi yera, atambira imbere y’ Uhoraho n’inkomezi ziwe zose.
Nuko Dawidi n’Abisirayeli bose, badugana Isandugu y’ Uhoraho batera akamo k’umunezero, bavuza n’inzamba.
Maze Isandugu y’Isezerano y’ Uhoraho yinjiye mu Gisagara ca Dawidi, Mikali umukobwa wa Sawuli abirabira mw’idirisha. Abonye umwami Dawidi atamba yiginagura, amugayira mu mutima.
Maze bazana ya Sandugu y’Uhoraho bayinjiza muri rya hema Dawidi yari yayishingiye, hanyuma batanga ibimazi biturirwa n’umuriro hamwe n’ivy’ishimwe imbere y’ Uhoraho .
Ahejeje gutanga ivyo bimazi biturirwa n’umuriro n’ivy’ishimwe, ahezagira abantu mw’izina ry’ Uhoraho Mushoboravyose.

Hanyuma aca agaburira umuntu wese mw’isinzi ry’Abisirayeli bari ngaho, abagabo n’abagore umwe wese akamuha umukate, inyama hamwe n’agakate gacumbwe mu nzabibu zumye. Ivyo biheze, bose baca barataha iwabo.

Dawidi asubiye iwe guhezagira abo mu nzu yiwe na bo, Mikali umukobwa wa Sawuli araza ngo amuhe ikaze, hanyuma aca amubwira ati: “Mbega icubahiro c’umwami w’Abisirayeli cari hehe, umuntu yiyambura impuzu imbere y’abaguranokazi bashumbiye abagurano biwe, nk’umuntu ata co amaze!”
Maze Dawidi aca abwira Mikali ati: “Nariko ndatambira Uhoraho , yantoranije kuruta so n’umuntu wese wo mu ruvyaro rwiwe ngo mbe umurongozi w’abantu biwe b’Abisirayeli, ni we nariko ndigina.
Kandi, ndashaka kurushaho kuboneka nk’uwutaco amaze, mbere mboneke ndi uwukengeretse cane mu maso yanje! Ariko imbere y’abo baguranokazi wavuze nzorushaho gushirwa hejuru.”
Maze Mikali umukobwa wa Sawuli ntiyaronka akana gushika arinde apfa.

headings.text: Bazana Isandugu y’ Uhoraho i Yerusalemu

verses.text: Umwami amaze gushika neza mu ngoro yiwe kandi Uhoraho amaze kumuha kuruhuka intambara z’abansi biwe bose bari bamukikije,
abwira Natani uwavugishwa n’Imana ati: “Ehe raba jewe mba mu nzu yubatswe n’ibiti vy’amasederi, nayo Isandugu y’Imana iba mw’ihema.”
Natani yishura umwami ati: “Ivyo wiyumvira gukora vyose, genda ubikore kuko Uhoraho ari kumwe nawe.”
Ariko muri iryo joro, ijambo ry’ Uhoraho riza kuri Natani riti:
“Genda ubwire umusavyi wanje Dawidi uti: ‘Uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze: Mbega ni wewe uzonyubakira inzu yo kubamwo?
Sinigeze mba mu nzu kuva igihe nakuriye Abisirayeli muri Egiputa gushika uwu musi. Namye nimuka mva mu kibanza kimwe nja mu kindi, nkibera mw’ihema.

Ahantu hose nimukiye ndi kumwe n’Abisirayeli bose, hari aho nigeze mbwira umutware n’umwe mu barongozi nabahaye ngo baragire ubwoko bwanje bw’Abisirayeli nti: Ni kuki mutanyubakira inzu mu biti vy’amasederi?’ ”
“None rero, genda ubwire umusavyi wanje Dawidi uti: ‘Uku ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze: Nagukuye mu bwungere aho waragira intama, ndagutoranya ngo ube uwuganza abantu banje b’Abisirayeli.
Nabanye nawe aho wagiye hose, kandi naherengeteje abansi bawe imbere yawe. None ngira nkuze izina ryawe ribe nk’amazina y’abahambaye bo kw’isi.

Kandi nzoha abantu banje b’Abisirayeli aho kuba, ndabateragire ahantu hatekanye ngo bagire inzu yabo bwite, aho batazokwongera kuburagizwa. Abansi babo ntibazosubira kubacinyiza nk’uko bahora babigira kera,
uhereye igihe nashiraho abacamanza bo kurongora abantu banje b’Abisirayeli. Nzoguha no kuruhuka intambara z’abansi bawe bose. Uhoraho ni we akumenyesheje ko ari we ubwiwe azokwubakira inzu.
Imisi yawe niyashira ukaja kuruhuka hamwe na ba sogokuruza bawe, nzohagurutsa uwo mu ruvyaro rwawe wo kugusubirira ku ngoma, akomoka kuri wewe, kandi nzokomeza ubwami bwiwe.
Ni we azokwubaka inzu yitirirwa izina ryanje, kandi nzokomeza intebe y’ubwami bwiwe ibihe bidashira.
Nzomubera se, na we azombera umwana. Niyakora ibibi, nzomuhanisha inkoni nk’uko umuvyeyi wese yobikora.
Ariko urukundo rwanje ntiruzokwigera rumuvako, nk’uko narukuye kuri Sawuli, uwo nagukuye imbere.
Inzu yawe n’ubwami bwawe bizokwamaho ibihe vyose imbere yanje; intebe y’inganji yawe izokwama ihangamye ibihe bidashira.’ ”
Nuko Natani aragenda ashikiriza Dawidi ayo majambo yose y’uko guhishurirwa.
Nuko umwami Dawidi arinjira yicara imbere y’ Uhoraho , maze avuga ati: “Jewe ndi iki, yewe Uhoraho Nyeninganji, kandi n’umuryango wanje wari iki, ko wanshikanye aha hose?

Kandi Uhoraho Nyeninganji, nk’aho umenga ibi ntibikwiye mu nyonga zawe, wongeyeko no kuvuga ibizoba ku nzu y’ubwami y’umusavyi wawe muri kazoza. None uko ni ko wama ugirira umuntu buntu, ga yewe Uhoraho Nyeninganji?
Mbega jewe Dawidi nokubwira ikindi ki? Ko uzi umusavyi wawe, ga yewe Uhoraho Nyeninganji!
Wakoze iki kintu gihambaye wongera ukimenyesha umusavyi wawe, kubera ijambo ryawe kandi nk’uko wabigomvye.
Mbega ukuntu uhambaye, ga yewe Uhoraho Nyeninganji! Nta n’umwe asa nawe, kandi nta yindi Mana atari wewe, nk’uko twavyiyumviye n’amatwi yacu.

Kandi ni irihe hanga kw’isi yose rimeze nk’abantu bawe b’Abisirayeli; ihanga Imana yihagurukiye ikaja gucungura kugira ngo ribe iryo yiharije? Izina ryawe warishize hejuru igihe wabacungura ubakuye muri Egiputa. Wakoze ibihambaye biteye ubwoba wirukana amahanga n’ibigirwamana vyayo vyari imbere y’abantu bawe wari wacunguye ubakura muri Egiputa.
Wihinduriye abantu bawe b’Abisirayeli kuba abo wiharije ibihe vyose, kandi nawe Uhoraho , wahindutse Imana yabo.
None rero, Uhoraho Mana, uze ukomeze iryo sezerano ibihe vyose iryo usezeraniye umusavyi wawe n’inzu yiwe. Uze ukore nk’uko wasezeranye,
kugira ngo izina ryawe rirushirize kuba irihambaye. Maze abantu bazovuge bati: ‘ Uhoraho Mushoboravyose ni Imana y’Abisirayeli!’ Kandi n’inzu y’umusavyi wawe Dawidi izokomerera imbere yawe.
Ewe Uhoraho Mushoboravyose, Mana y’Abisirayeli, wahishuriye ibi umusavyi wawe, uvuga uti: ‘Nzokwubakira inzu.’ None rero umusavyi wawe natewe intege zo kuza ngo ngusenge iri sengesho.
None rero Uhoraho Nyeninganji, uri Imana! Amajambo yawe ni ayo kwizigirwa, kandi usezeraniye umusavyi wawe ibi vyiza bingana bityo.

None rero nibiguhimbare guhezagira inzu y’umusavyi wawe, kugira ngo yame imbere y’inyonga zawe ibihe vyose; kuko wewe Uhoraho Nyeninganji, ari wewe wabivuze, kandi inzu y’umusavyi wawe izohezagirwa ibihe vyose ku bw’umuhezagiro wawe.”
Inyuma y’ivyo, Dawidi atera Abafilisitiya arabanesha, abagira abagurano biwe mu kubanyaga igisagara kinini citwa Gati.

Dawidi arongera anesha Abanyamowabu. Abaryamika hasi ku murongo abapimisha umugozi; aca yica ibice bibiri vya bitatu vy’abaryamye, asigaza ica gatatu gusa. Nuko Abanyamowabu atishe abagira abagurano biwe bakama bamuzanira amashikanwa yo kumwisaba.
Dawidi yongera anesha Hadadezeri mwene Rehobu umwami w’i Zoba, igihe yagomba kugarukana icibutso ciwe mu karere k’uruzi Efurate.

Dawidi amunyaga imikogote igihumbi, abayigenderamwo ibihumbi indwi n’abasoda bagwanira ku maguru ibihumbi mirongo ibiri. Acagagura ibinono vy’amafarasi akwega iyo mikogote, asigaza ayo gukwega imikogote ijana gusa.
Maze Abaramu b’i Damasiko baja gutabara Hadadezeri umwami w’i Zoba, Dawidi abicamwo abantu ibihumbi mirongo ibiri na bibiri.
Aca ashinga ibirindiro i Damasiko ku mugwa mukuru w’i Siriya kandi Abaramu bacika abagurano biwe, bakama bamuzanira amashikanwa yo kumwisaba. Uhoraho yama aha Dawidi intsinzi aho yaja hose.
Dawidi afata inkinzo z’inzahabu zari iz’intwazangabo za Hadadezeri azijana i Yerusalemu.
Mu bisagara vy’i Beta n’i Berotayi vyari ivya Hadadezeri, umwami Dawidi ahanyaga ubutare bwinshi bw’umwakaka.
Maze Towi umwami w’i Hamati yumvise ko Dawidi yanesheje ingabo zose za Hadadezeri,
aca arungika umuhungu wiwe Yoramu ku mwami Dawidi, kumuramutsa no kumukeza kuko yanesheje Hadadezeri, yahora yama amugwanya. Yoramu agenda ajanye ibikoresho vy’ifeza, vy’inzahabu n’ivy’umwakaka.
Umwami Dawidi aca yegurira Uhoraho ivyo bikoresho vyose, nk’uko yari yabigize ku nzahabu n’ifeza yari yakuye mu bihugu vyose yari yaranesheje ari vyo
vy’Abanyedomu, Abanyamowabu, Abamoni, Abafilisitiya, n’Abamaleki. Atanga kandi n’iminyago yose yari yakuye kwa Hadadezeri mwene Rehobu umwami w’i Zoba.
Maze Dawidi aba rurangiranwa avuye kunesha Abanyedomu ibihumbi cumi n’umunani, abatsinze mu Kiyaya c’Umunyu.
Ashira ibirindiro mu gihugu ca Edomu, mu gihugu cose ahashira ibirindiro, kandi Abanyedomu bose baca baba abagurano ba Dawidi. Uhoraho yama aha intsinzi Dawidi aho yaja hose.
Dawidi aganza Abisirayeli bose, akora ibibereye n’ibigororotse ku bantu biwe bose.
Yowabu mwene Zeruwiya ni we yari umukuru w’ingabo; Yehoshafati mwene Ahiludi na we yari umwanditsi w’ivyaja biraba;
Sadoki mwene Ahitubu na Ahimeleki mwene Abiyatari bari abaherezi; Seraya yari umunyamabanga;
Benaya mwene Yehoyada yari ajejwe Abakereti n’Abapeleti; kandi abahungu ba Dawidi bari abarongozi.

headings.text: Abakuru bo ku ngoma ya Dawidi

verses.text: Dawidi arabaza ati: “Mbega hoba hari umuntu n’umwe agisigaye mu bo mu muryango wa Sawuli kugira ngo ndamugirire neza kubera Yonatani?”
Hariho umusuku mu bakozi ba Sawuli yitwa Ziba. Baramuhamagara ngo arenguke imbere ya Dawidi, maze umwami aramubaza ati: “Ni wewe Ziba?” Aramwishura ati: “Umusavyi wawe ndi hano.”

Umwami aramubaza ati: “Nta n’umwe yoba agisigaye mu bantu bo mu muryango wa Sawuli, noshobora kwereka ukugira neza kw’Imana?” Ziba yishura umwami ati: “Hariho umuhungu wa Yonatani; amugaye amaguru yose.”
Umwami amubaza ati: “Ari hehe?” Ziba aramwishura ati: “Aba kwa Makiri mwene Amiyeli i Lo Debari.”
Nuko umwami Dawidi asaba ko bamukura i Lo Debari, kwa Makiri mwene Amiyeli.
Mefibosheti mwene Yonatani, umuhungu wa Sawuli ashitse kwa Dawidi, aramwunamira amuha icubahiro. Dawidi aravuga ati: “Mefibosheti!” Aramwishura ati: “Ndi hano umusavyi wawe.”
Dawidi amubwira ati: “Ntutinye, kuko nzokugirira neza kubera so Yonatani. Nzogukomorera ivyari ivya sogokuru wawe Sawuli, kandi uzohora usangira nanje ku meza yanje.”
Mefibosheti arunama avuga ati: “Jewe umusavyi wawe ndi iki, aho unyitaho meze nk’imbwa ipfuye?”
Nuko umwami atumako Ziba, umusuku wa Sawuli, aramubwira ati: “Mpaye umwuzukuru wa shobuja ivyari ivya Sawuli n’umuryango wiwe.

Wewe n’abahungu bawe n’abagurano bawe muzomurimira mumuzanire ivyimburwa, kugira ngo umwuzukuru wa shobuja yamane ibikwiye. Kandi Mefibosheti, umwuzukuru wa shobuja, azokwama afungurira ku meza yanje.” (Ico gihe Ziba yari afise abahungu icumi na batanu n’abagurano mirongo ibiri.)
Maze Ziba abwira umwami ati: “Umusavyi wawe nzokora ivyo databuja umwami avuze vyose.” Nuko Mefibosheti afungurira ku meza ya Dawidi nk’umwe wo mu bana b’umwami.
Mefibosheti yari afise umuhungu yitwa Mika, kandi abo mu rugo kwa Ziba bose bari abagurano ba Mefibosheti.
Maze Mefibosheti aba i Yerusalemu, kuko imisi yose yafungura ku meza y’umwami, kandi yari amugaye amaguru yose.
Hanyuma y’ivyo, umwami w’Abamoni arapfa, maze umuhungu wiwe Hanuni amusubirira ku ngoma.

Dawidi ariyumvira ati: “Nzogirira neza Hanuni mwene Nahashi, nk’uko se yangiriye neza.” Nuko Dawidi arungika intumwa ngo zije kumwirura kuko yari yabuze se. Abantu ba Dawidi bashitse mu gihugu c’Abamoni,

abaganwa bo mu Bamoni babwira Hanuni umwami wabo bati: “Wibaza ko Dawidi yubashe so mu kurungika abantu bo kukugarukirako? Aho ntiyabarungitse ngo batate igisagara kugira ngo hanyuma bazoce baza kugitera bagisangangure?”
Nuko Hanuni afata ba bantu ba Dawidi, abamwa ubwanwa umusaya umwe, atabura amakanzu yabo kuva aho itako ritangurira, aca arabarungika.
Dawidi avyumvise, aca arungika intumwa ngo zihure na bo, kuko bari buzuye ibiteterwe. Umwami abatumako ati: “Nimugume i Yeriko gushika aho ubwanwa bwanyu buzokurira, hanyuma muze mubone kugaruka.”

Abamoni babonye ko bakoze ikintu giteye isoni imbere ya Dawidi, baca bahera abasoda b’Abasiriya ibihumbi mirongo ibiri bagwanira ku maguru bava i Beti-Rehobu n’i Aramu-Zoba, n’abantu igihumbi b’umwami Mayaka, n’ibihumbi cumi na bibiri bavuye i Tobu.
Dawidi avyumvise aca arungika Yowabu n’ingabo zose zizi kugwana.
Abamoni baragenda batonda urugamba kw’irembo ry’igisagara cabo, Abarameya b’i Zoba na Rehobu n’abo i Tobu na Mayaka batonda urugamba inyuma y’igisagara.
Yowabu abona ko urugamba rumuturutse imbere n’inyuma; aca atoranya bamwe mu ngabo z’indobanurwa mu Bisirayeli abarungika ngo bagwanye Abarameya.
Abasigaye abazeza murumunawe Abishayi ngo abatware, aca abatuma kugwanya Abamoni.
Yowabu amubwira ati: “Abarameya nibandusha inkomezi, uraza kuntabara; ariko kandi Abamoni nibakurusha inkomezi, ndaza kugutabara.
Nureme kandi tugwane rugabo, tugwanire ihanga ryacu n’ibisagara vy’Imana yacu. Uhoraho ari bukore ivyo abona ko ari vyiza mu nyonga ziwe.”
Maze Yowabu n’ingabo bari kumwe baragenda ngo bagwane n’Abarameya, na bo barabahunga.
Abamoni babonye ko Abarameya bariko barahunga, na bo bahunga Abishayi binjira mu gisagara. Nuko Yowabu arahindukira areka kugwanya Abamoni asubira i Yerusalemu.
Abarameya babonye ko baneshejwe n’Abisirayeli, basubira gutororokana.
Hadadezeri azana Abarameya bavuye hakurya y’uruzi Efurate; baja i Helamu, barongowe na Shobaki umukuru w’ingabo za Hadadezeri.
Dawidi avyumvise, akoranya Abisirayeli bose bajabuka Yorodani baja i Helamu. Abasiriya batonda urugamba ngo baje guhura na Dawidi bagwane na we.

Ariko Abarameya bahunga Abisirayeli, kandi Dawidi yica amajana indwi mu bagwanira ku mikogote n’ibihumbi mirongo ine vy’abagwanira ku maguru. Aca akomeretsa Shobaki umukuru w’ingabo zabo, hanyuma aca agwa aho nyene.

Abami bose batwarwa na Hadadezeri babonye ko baneshejwe n’Abisirayeli, baca bagiriranira amasezerano y’amahoro n’Abisirayeli, bemera kuba abagurano babo no kubakorera. Maze Abarameya baca baratinya ntibongera gufasha Abamoni.

Mu gihe imvura yaba itanguye kugabanuka hakaza ici, ni ho abami bahora baja mu ntambara. Maze Dawidi arungika Yowabu n’intwazangabo hamwe n’ingabo zose z’Abisirayeli kugwana. Banesha Abamoni hanyuma bugariza igisagara caho citwa Raba, ariko Dawidi wewe yigumira i Yerusalemu.
Umusi umwe, ku mugoroba Dawidi aravyuka aba aratembera ku nzu yo hejuru y’ikirimba ciwe. Maze ari aho abona umugore ariko ariyuhagira. Uwo mugore yari mwiza cane,
maze Dawidi aca arungika umuntu kugira amenye uwo mugore uwo ari we. Uwo muntu amubwira ati: “Urya si Batisheba, umukobwa wa Eliyamu akaba umugore wa Uriya Umuheti?”
Nuko Dawidi aca atuma intumwa ngo bamuzane. Aza iwe, maze bararyamana. (Yari yihumanuye avuye mu mihango yiwe.) Nuko araheza ataha iwe.
Uwo mugore aca asama inda hanyuma arungikira ubutumwa Dawidi amubwira ati: “Mfise inda.”
Nuko Dawidi aca arungikira ubutumwa Yowabu ati: “Ndungikira Uriya Umuheti.” Maze Yowabu aca aramumurungikira.
Uriya ashitse iwe, Dawidi amubaza amakuru ya Yowabu, uko ingabo zimeze n’uko urugamba rwariko ruragenda.
Maze Dawidi abwira Uriya ati: “Manuka uje iwawe woge ibirenge.” Nuko Uriya ava ku kirimba, maze umwami amukurikiza intumwa imushiriye ingabire y’inzimano.
Ariko Uriya ntiyataha iwe, ahubwo aja kwiryamira kw’irembo ry’ikirimba hamwe n’abarinzi ba shebuja.
Babwira Dawidi bati: “Erega Uriya ntiyagiye i muhira iwe.” Maze Dawidi aramubaza ati: “Ko wari uje uva ku rugendo rurerure, ni kuki utatashe i muhira?”

Uriya abwira Dawidi ati: “Isandugu y’Isezerano, Abisirayeli n’Abayuda barara mu mahema, kandi na databuja Yowabu n’abantu b’umwami barara mu gahinga. Nogenda iwanje gute nkarya nkanywa nkaryamana n’umugore wanje? Ndahiye wewe nyene sinokora ikintu nk’ico!”
Nuko Dawidi aramubwira ati: “Guma ngaha uwundi musi umwe, maze ejo nzokurungika.” Nuko Uriya aguma i Yerusalemu uwo musi n’uwukurikira.
Dawidi aramutumira ngo basangire ku mfungurwa no ku binyobwa vyiwe, aramuboreza. Ariko ku mugoroba Uriya arasohoka aja kuryama ku gisegure ciwe hamwe n’abarinzi ba shebuja, ntiyigera ataha iwe.
Bukeye mu gitondo Dawidi yandikira ikete Yowabu arirungikana Uriya.
Muri ryo yanditse ati: “Ushire Uriya imbere aho urugamba rukomeye. Maze muce mumureka wenyene mwigireyo kugira ngo bamurase apfe.”
Nuko igihe Yowabu yari agicunze igisagara bari bugarije, ashira Uriya mu kibanza yari azi ko hari abagwanyi bakomeye.
Abantu bo muri ico gisagara basohotse kugwanya Yowabu, bamwe mu ngabo za Dawidi barapfa; na Uriya Umuheti na we arapfa.
Yowabu arungikira Dawidi inkuru zo ku rugamba.
Yihanikiriza uwo yari atumye ati: “Niwaheza gushikiriza umwami iyo nkuru y’urugamba,
umwami ashobora gushavura, agaca akubaza ati: ‘Ni igiki catumye mwegera cane ico gisagara mu kugwana? Ntimwari muzi ko bashobora kubarasa imyampi bari ku ruzitiro?

Ni nde yishe Abimeleki mwene Yerubi Besheti? Si umugore yamuteye ingasiro ari ku ruzitiro, agaca apfira i Tebezi? Ni iki catumye mwegera uruzitiro?’ Niyakubaza ivyo, uce umubwira uti: ‘Kandi umusavyi wawe Uriya Umuheti na we nyene yapfuye.’ ”
Uwatumwe aragenda, maze ashitse abwira Dawidi ivyo Yowabu yamutumye vyose kuvuga.
Uwo yatumwe arongera abwira Dawidi ati: “Abagwanira igisagara baturushije inkomezi maze barasohoka baduterera inyuma y’igisagara, ariko twabashubije inyuma gushika kw’irembo ry’igisagara.
Maze abanyamiheto bari hejuru ku rugo, baca bararasa imyampi ku basavyi bawe, hanyuma bamwe mu bantu bawe barapfa. Kandi n’umusavyi wawe Uriya Umuheti yapfuye.”
Dawidi abwira iyo ntumwa ati: “Bwira Yowabu uti: ‘Ivyo ntibikubabaze; inkota irya umwe canke uwundi. Bandanya urugamba kuri ico gisagara maze ugisambure.’ Uvuge ivyo kugira ngo uremeshe Yowabu.”
Muka Uriya yumvise ko umugabo wiwe yapfuye, aramugandarira.
Ikigandaro giheze, Dawidi amuzana iwe, aba umugore wiwe maze avyarana na we umuhungu. Ariko ico umwami Dawidi yakoze kibabaza Uhoraho .
Uhoraho atuma Natani kuri Dawidi. Ashitse aho ari, amubwira ati: “Mu gisagara kimwe hariho abagabo babiri, umwe yari umutunzi, uwundi yari umukene.
Uwo mutunzi yari afise intama nyinshi cane n’ibindi bitungwa,

ariko wa mukene we nta kindi yari afise atari akagazi k’intama kamwe yari yaraguze. Yarakoroye, karakura kabana na we n’abana biwe. Karya ku ndya ziwe, kakanywera ku gikombe ciwe, kakaryama mu maboko yiwe. Kari kameze nk’agakobwa kiwe.”

“Maze haza umushitsi kwa wa mutunzi, ariko ntiyakura muri za ntama ziwe canke mu bindi bitungwa, ivyo kuzimana umushitsi wiwe. Ahubwo, aragenda afata ka gatama ka wa mworo aba ari ko abaga azimana uwo mushitsi.”
Dawidi ishavu riramurya, abwira Natani ati: “Ndahiye uguhoraho kw’ Uhoraho , uwo muntu yakoze ivyo akwiye gupfa!
Ategerezwa kuriha ako kagazi k’intama incuro zine, kuko yakoze ikintu nk’ico ntagire akagongwe.”
Maze Natani abwira Dawidi ati: “Uwo muntu ni wewe! Uku ni ko Uhoraho , Imana ya Isirayeli avuze: ‘Nagusize amavuta ngo ube umwami w’Abisirayeli, ndagukura mu kuboko kwa Sawuli.
Naguhaye inzu ya shobuja, n’abagore biwe ndabashira mu maboko yawe. Naguhaye ingoma ya Isirayeli n’iya Yuda. Kandi nimba ivyo vyari bike, nari kukwongera n’ibindi.
None ni kuki wakengereye ijambo ry’ Uhoraho ugakora ikintu kibi nk’ico mu nyonga ziwe? Wicishije Uriya Umuheti inkota y’Abamoni, maze uca wigarurira umugore wiwe umugira rwawe.
None rero, uhereye ubu, inkota ntizova mu nzu yawe, kuko wankengereye ugatwara umugore wa Uriya Umuheti ukamugira rwawe.’ ”
“Uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze: ‘Kubera ivyo wakoze, nzotuma ivyago bikuzako bivuye mu bo mu nzu yawe. Nzofata abagore bawe ndabahe umuntu wa hafi yawe, aryamane na bo ku murango izuba riva.
Ivyo wakoze wabikoze mw’ibanga, ariko jeho nzobikora ku murango izuba ryaka imbere y’Abisirayeli bose.’ ”
Nuko Dawidi aratura abwira Natani ati: “Naracumuye k’ Uhoraho .” Natani aramwishura ati: “Ni vyo, mugabo Uhoraho yakugiriye ikigongwe ntugipfuye kubera ico caha.
Ariko, kubera agakengerwe kangana gatyo werekanye k’ Uhoraho mu gukora ivyo, wa mwana wavyara wewe arapfa.”
Natani amaze gutaha, Uhoraho atuma wa mwana muka Uriya yavyarana na Dawidi agwara.
Dawidi asabira uwo mwana ku Mana kugira ngo amureke abeho. Arisonzesha, aja mu nzu yiwe amara amajoro yitembagaza hasi yambaye amagunira.
Abakuru b’umuryango wiwe bahagarara i ruhande yiwe ngo bamwinginge ave hasi, ariko aranka, kandi ntiyagira ico afungurana na bo.

Ku musi ugira indwi wa mwana arapfa. Abishikira ba Dawidi baratinya kubimubwira, kuko biyumvira bati: “Ko yakoze ivyo, ntatwumvirize igihe uwo mwana yari akiriho, twomubwira gute ko umwana yapfuye? Erega yohava akora igikorwa c’uwihebuye.”
Dawidi abona abantu biwe bariko barongorerana aca amenya ko wa mwana yapfuye. Arababaza ati: “Wa mwana yapfuye?” Baramwishura bati: “Egome, yapfuye.”
Nuko Dawidi ava hasi. Ahejeje kwiyuhagira, yisiga amavuta yambara n’impuzu ziwe, aja mu ngoro y’ Uhoraho aramuhimbaza. Maze aca yisubirira iwe, asaba ko bamuzanira imfungurwa, maze arafungura.
Abasuku biwe baramubaza bati: “Ni kuki ukoze uko? Umwana akiriho, warisonzesheje urarira, ariko ubu umwana apfuye, urahagurutse urafungura!”
Arabishura ati: “Umwana akiriho, narisonzesheje ndarira. Nariyumviriye nti: ‘Nta wubizi, kumbure, Uhoraho ashobora kungirira ubuntu umwana agakira.’
Ariko ko yapfuye, nokwisonzeshereza iki? Mbega nosubira kumuzura? Jewe nzomusanga iyo ari, ariko we ntazogaruka aho ndi.”
Nuko Dawidi aremesha umugore wiwe Batisheba, aragenda aryamana na we. Maze Batisheba asama iyindi nda avyara umwana w’umuhungu, bamwita Salomo. Uhoraho aramukunda;
maze kuko yamukunze, aca atuma uwavugishwa na we Natani ngo bamwite Yedidiya (risobanurwa ngo uwukunzwe n’ Uhoraho ).
Muri ico gihe nyene, Yowabu yari yateye i Raba mu Bamoni araheza afata umugwa mukuru w’umwami waho.
Yowabu aca atuma intumwa kuri Dawidi, kumubwira ziti: “Nagwanye n’abantu b’i Raba kandi nafashe igisagara c’umugende ubaha amazi.
Ubu rero, koranya ingabo zisigaye zose kugira ngo uze wugarize hanyuma ufate igisagara cose. Bitabaye uko nohava ndagifata, hanyuma abantu bagaca bakinyitirira.”
Nuko Dawidi akoranya ingabo zose aja i Raba, arahatera arahafata.

Yambura umwami waho urugori rw’ubwami rwari ku mutwe wiwe, asanga rufise uburemere bw’italanto imwe y’inzahabu, kandi rwari rusharijwe n’utubuye tw’agaciro, baca barwambika Dawidi. Atwara iminyago myinshi akuye muri ico gisagara,

atwara n’abantu bo muri ico gisagara, abashingira ibikebere, bamwe baba abasatura imbaho, abandi bagakoresha amasipiri n’incabiti, abandi bagasatura amabuye, abandi na bo bagafyatura amatafari. Ivyo abikora mu bisagara vyose vy’Abamoni. Hanyuma Dawidi n’ingabo zose basubira i Yerusalemu.
Inyuma y’ivyo, Amunoni mwene Dawidi akunda cane Tamari, umukobwa mwiza bavukana kandi akaba mushiki wa Abusalomu uwundi muhungu wa Dawidi.
Amunoni agira ivyipfuzo vyinshi bimurengeye gushika aho amera nk’uwugwaye kubera ivyo vyipfuzo. Kubera yuko Tamari atari bwigere aryamana n’umugabo, Amunoni abona ko ata kuntu ashobora kumuronka.
Ariko Amunoni yari afise umugenzi yitwa Yonadabu mwene Shimeya, umuvukanyi wa Dawidi. Yonadabu yari umuntu aciye akenge.

Umusi umwe, abaza Amunoni ati: “Ni igiki gituma, wewe umwana w’umwami, uboneka wacitse intege uko imisi ihera? Ntiwobimbwira?” Amunoni aramubwira ati: “Nkunda cane Tamari, mushiki wa Abusalomu umuvukanyi.”

Yonadabu aca amubwira ati: “Reka ndakubwire uko ubigenza: genda uryame wigire nk’uwugwaye. Maze so niyaza kukuraba, uce umubwira uti: ‘Nshaka ko mushikanje Tamari yoza anzaniye ivyokurya. Abitegurire aho mbona hanyuma aheze abinyihere.’ ”

Nuko Amunoni araryama yigira uwugwaye. Maze umwami aje kumuraba, Amunoni amubwira ati: “Nashaka ko mushikanje Tamari yoza agategurira udukate imbere yanje aho mbona, kugira ngo nshobore kuturya antamitse.”
Dawidi atumako Tamari ku kirimba ati: “Genda ku nzu ya musazawe Amunoni umutegurire ico arya.”
Maze Tamari aja kwa musazawe Amunoni, na we akaba yari aryamye. Atwara ifu, arayicumba, akora udukate mu maso yiwe aratwotsa.
Nuko afata isahani maze amuzanira twa dukate, ariko yanka kurya. Amunoni avuga ati: “Sohora abari hano bose.” Maze bose barasohoka.
Nuko Amunoni abwira Tamari ati: “Nzanira ivyo vyokurya ku buriri ubinyihere.” Maze Tamari yakira twa dukate yari yateguye atuzanira musazawe Amunoni mu cumba yaryamamwo.
Ariko amuhereje ngo yakire arye, aca aramusumira aramufata amubwira ati: “Mushikanje Tamari, emera turyamane.”
Aramwishura ati: “Oya, mwana wa data. Kandi ntumfate ku nguvu! Ikintu nk’ico ntigikwiye gukorwa mu Bisirayeli! Ntukore ikibi nk’ico.
Mbega noheza ivyo biteterwe nkabijana hehe? Mbere na wewe woba ubaye nk’umwe mu bipfamutima vyo muri Isirayeli. Ndakwinginze vugana n’umwami; kuko atokunyima ngo undongore.”
Ariko ntiyamwumviriza, kandi kuko yamurusha inkomezi, amufata ku nguvu asambana na we.
Nuko Amunoni aca amwanka urunuka. Ndetse urwanko yamwanse rusumba urukundo yari yamukunze. Amunoni aca amubwira ati: “Va ngaha, sohoka!”
Tamari amwishura ati: “Oya reka kunyirukana, kuko woba ukoze ikindi kibi kiruta n’ico umaze kunkorera.” Ariko ntiyamwumviriza.
Ahamagara umukozi wiwe ati: “Sohora uwu mukobwa ave hano uce wugara urugi.”
Nuko wa mukozi wiwe aca aramusohora, maze yugara urugi. Yari yambaye ikanzu nziza y’igiciro isharijwe amabara menshi, kuko ari ko abakobwa b’umwami batarigera baryamana n’abagabo bambara.
Tamari aca yisiga iminyota ku mutwe atabagura na ya kanzu y’amabara y’igiciro yari yambaye. Aca yikorera amaboko agenda araboroga inzira yose.

Musazawe Abusalomu aca amubwira ati: “Mbega Amunoni, musazawe yari kumwe nawe? Ihorere, mushikanje; ni musazawe. Ntubishireko umutima.” Maze Tamari aca aja kuba mu nzu kwa musazawe Abusalomu, amera nk’umugore yahebwe.
Umwami Dawidi avyumvise, arashavura cane.
Abusalomu ntiyigera asubira kuvugisha ikintu na kimwe Amunoni, caba ciza canke kibi; yaramwanka cane kuko yononye mushikiwe Tamari.
Imyaka ibiri iheze, mu gihe abamwa ubwoya bw’intama za Abusalomu bari i Bayali-Hazori hafi y’urugabano rwa Efurayimu, Abusalomu aca atumira abahungu b’umwami bose ngo baze mu musi mukuru.
Abusalomu ashikira umwami amubwira ati: “Umusavyi wawe naramutse nkoresha abamwa ubwoya bw’intama. Mbega umwami n’abanyacubahiro biwe bontera iteka ryo kuza kwifatanya nanje?”
Umwami aramwishura ati: “Oya mwana. Twese ntitwoza; twohava tukubera umuzigo.” Naho Abusalomu yagumye amwinginga cane, ntiyamwemerera kugenda, ariko aramuhezagira.
Nuko Abusalomu aca avuga ati: “Ko bidashobotse, ndakwinginze undungikire umuvukanyi wanje Amunoni wewe aze tujane.” Umwami aramubaza ati: “Ni kuki ugomba ko ajana nawe?”
Ariko Abusalomu aramugobera cane, maze arateba aremera ko bajana na Amunoni n’abandi bahungu b’umwami bose.

Abusalomu aca atanga itegeko ku bantu biwe ati: “Umviriza! Murindire kugeza igihe Amunoni azoba amaze kunywa umuvinyu akaborerwa nca ndababwira nti: ‘Mwice,’ muce mumwica. Ntimutinye. Si jewe ndabibabwiye? Mukomere ntimutinye.”
Nuko rero abantu ba Abusalomu baronse ikimenyetso baca bica Amunoni nk’uko Abusalomu yari yabategetse. Nuko abahungu b’umwami bose bava hasi, burira indogoba zabo bariruka barahunga.
Bakiri mu nzira, inkuru ishikira Dawidi ivuga iti: “Abusalomu yishe abahungu b’umwami bose; nta n’umwe muri bo yasigaye.”
Umwami arahaguruka, yitabagurirako impuzu yicara hasi; maze abagendanyi biwe bahagarara i ruhande yiwe bitabaguriyeko impuzu zabo.

Ariko Yonadabu mwene Shimeya, uwo bavukana na Dawidi avuga ati: “Umwami wanje ntiyibwire ko bishe abaganwa bose; Amunoni wenyene ni we yapfuye. Ivyo ni ivyo Abusalomu yari yaragize umugambi kuva umusi Amunoni yonona mushikiwe Tamari.
Nyakwubahwa mwami ntushire umutima kuri iyo nkuru ivuga ko abahungu b’umwami bose bapfuye. Ni Amunoni wenyene yapfuye.”

Ariko Abusalomu we, yari yahunze. Hanyuma umuteramyi ari ku rugo rw’i Yerusalemu agize gutya, abona abantu benshi bariko baraza bamanuka umusozi mw’ibarabara riva mu burengero. Uwo muteramyi ariruka abibwira umwami ati: “Ndabonye abantu baje bava i Horonayimu, bari mu mbavu z’umusozi.”
Yonadabu aca abwira umwami ati: “Ehe, abahungu b’umwami barashitse; bibaye nk’uko umusavyi wawe yabivuze.”
Agiheza kuvuga, abahungu b’umwami binjira baboroga cane. Umwami na we nyene, n’abakozi biwe, barirana na bo cane.
Abusalomu na we arahunga aja kwa sekuru Talumayi mwene Amihudi, umwami w’i Geshuri. Maze Dawidi agandarira umuhungu wiwe Amunoni imisi myinshi.
Abusalomu na we arahunga aja i Geshuri, amarayo imyaka itatu.
Ariko umwami Dawidi amaze kwirurwa umubabaro wa Amunoni atangura kwiyumvira ingene yosubiza hamwe na Abusalomu.
Yowabu mwene Zeruwiya amenya ko umutima w’umwami ukumbuye Abusalomu.

Nuko Yowabu aca arungika umuntu i Tekowa aronderayo umugore w’umunyabwenge. Amubwira ati: “Niwigire nk’uwugandaye. Wambare impuzu zo kugandara, kandi ntiwisige amavuta. Wigire nk’umugore amaze imisi myinshi ababajwe n’uwapfuye.
Maze uce uja ku mwami umubwire aya majambo.” Maze Yowabu amubwira amajambo ategerezwa kuvuga.
Wa mugore w’i Tekowa agiye kuraba umwami, aramwunamira, amubwira ati: “Mwami Nyeningoma, mfasha!”
Umwami aramubaza ati: “Ni ibiki bikugoye?” Wa mugore aca avuga ati: “Jewe ndi umupfakazi; umugabo wanje yarapfuye.
Jewe umusavyikazi wawe nari mfise abahungu babiri. Maze bagwanira mu murima, ata n’umwe wo kubabanguranya. Umwe akubita uwundi maze aramwica.

None umuryango wose wahagurukiye umusavyikazi wawe; bavuga bati: ‘Tanga uwo yishe umuvukanyi wiwe, kugira ngo na we yicwe azize ko yishe uwo bavukana. Ntabereye kuzoragwa ikintu na kimwe co mu muryango.’ Uko ni ko bagomba kuzimya ikara rimwe ryari rikiriko riraka, ngo ntibasigarane izina umugabo wanje canke uwumukomokako n’umwe kw’isi.”
Umwami abwira wa mugore ati: “Itahire, nanje ndatanga itegeko rigukiza.”
Ariko wa mugore w’i Tekowa aramubwira ati: “Mwami nyeningoma, reka igicumuro kigume kuri jewe no ku muryango wa data, ariko umwami n’ingoma yiwe ntihagire ikimwagiriza.”
Umwami aramwishura ati: “Nihagira uwukubwira ijambo na rimwe, uze umunzanire, ntazosubira kukugora.”

Wa mugore aravuga ati: “Umwami natakambire Uhoraho Imana yiwe kugira ngo umuhozi ntasese amaraso ku yandi, mu kwica umuhungu wanje.” Umwami avuga ati: “Nkurahiye Uguhoraho k’ Uhoraho , nta n’agashatsi ko ku mutwe w’umuhungu wawe kazokorokera hasi.”
Nuko wa mugore aca avuga ati: “Mwami Nyeningabo, nyemerera jewe umusavyikazi wawe ngire ico ndakubwiye.” Aramwishura ati: “Vuga.”
Wa mugore aravuga ati: “Ni kuki wateguye gukorera ubwoko bw’Imana ikibi nk’ico? Mbega umwami ko avuze atyo, ntiyitsindishije ko atagarukanye umuhungu wiwe yangarijwe mu mahanga?
Nk’uko amazi asesetse atayorwa, ni ko natwe tuzopfa twese. Ariko ubwo si bwo bugombe bw’Imana, ahubwo yoyo irondera inzira yo kutugarukana iyo twatandukanye na yo.
Ubu rero nazanywe no kubwira iryo jambo umwami wanje kuko abantu banteye ubwoba. Umusavyikazi wawe niyumviriye nti: ‘Reka ngende tuvugane n’umwami; kumbure yokora ico umusavyikazi wiwe amusavye.
Kumbure umwami yokwemera gutabara umusavyi wiwe akamukura mu kuboko kw’umuntu agomba kunyaga jewe n’umuhungu wanje umugabane twahawe n’Imana.’ ”

“None rero umusavyikazi wawe navuga nti: ‘Icompa ijambo ry’umwami wanje rikanzanira gutekanirwa mu mugabane wanje, kuko umwami wanje ameze nk’umumarayika w’Imana mu vyo kumenya ikibi n’iciza. Icompa Uhoraho Imana yawe akabana nawe.’ ”
Maze umwami abwira uwo mugore ati: “Unyishure utampishije na kimwe mu vyo ngiye kukubaza.” Wa mugore avuga ati: “Umwami wanje navuge.”

Umwami arabaza ati: “Mbega muri ibi vyose nta kuboko kwa Yowabu kurimwo?” Wa mugore aramwishura ati: “Ndahiye wewe nyene, mwami wanje, nta n’umwe ashobora gukebereza i buryo canke i bumoso ku ryo umwami wanje avuze. Egome ni umusavyi wawe Yowabu yambwiye gukora ivyo, ambwira n’ivyo nkwiye kuvuga.
Umusavyi wawe Yowabu yabikoze kugira ngo iki gihe kirangire. Umwami wanje afise ubwenge nk’ubw’umumarayika w’Imana azi vyose mu bibera mu gihugu.”
Maze umwami atuma intumwa kubwira Yowabu iti: “Ni vyiza, aremeye kubikora. Genda ugarukane uwo muhungu Abusalomu.”
Yowabu arunama ashika hasi, araheza ahezagira umwami. Yowabu aravuga ati: “Uyu musi umusavyi wawe menye ko nagiriwe ubuntu imbere yawe, mwami wanje, kuko umwami ahaye umusavyi wiwe ivyo yasavye.”
Nuko Yowabu aja i Geshuri agarukana Abusalomu i Yerusalemu.
Ariko umwami aravuga ati: “Aze aje mu nzu yiwe, ariko ntaze aze ngo abone mu maso hanje.” Nuko Abusalomu aja mu nzu yiwe ntiyigera aza aho abona umwami.
Mu Bisirayeli bose nta muntu n’umwe yarangwa ko ari mwiza ku karanga nka Abusalomu. Kuva ku mutwe gushika ku kirenge ciwe nta gasembwa yari afise.
Ku mwaka ku mwaka yarimosha umushatsi kuko yaba yumva umuremereye. Yaca awupima, maze uburemere bwawo bwari shekeli amajana abiri upimishije umunzane w’i bwami.
Abusalomu yari yaravyaye abahungu batatu n’umukobwa umwe. Uwo mukobwa yitwa Tamari, maze aba mwiza cane.
Abusalomu aba i Yerusalemu atabona umwami mu maso.
Nuko Abusalomu atumako Yowabu kugira ngo amutume ku mwami, ariko Yowabu aranka kumwitaba. Nuko amutumako ubugira kabiri ariko na ho nyene aranka kuza.
Maze abwira abakozi biwe ati: “Murabona, umurima wa Yowabu ukurikirana n’uwanje, kandi arafiseyo ingano. Genda muziturire.” Nuko abakozi ba Abusalomu baragenda baturira wa murima.
Nuko Yowabu aca aja kwa Abusalomu aramubwira ati: “Ni kuki abakozi bawe bantuririye umurima?”

Abusalomu abwira Yowabu ati: “Ni kubera nagutumyeko nti: ‘Nuze ndagutume ku mwami kubaza uti: “Ni kuki wankuye i Geshuri? Vyari kumbera vyiza iyo nigumira hariya!” ’ None rero, ndagomba kubona mu nyonga z’umwami, kandi nihaba hari icaha kinyagira, anyice.”
Nuko Yowabu aja ku mwami amubwira ivyo. Maze umwami atumako Abusalomu, na we araza arunama imbere y’umwami. Umwami aramugumbira.
Inyuma y’ivyo, Abusalomu yironkera umukogote n’amafarasi n’abantu mirongo itanu bagendera imbere yiwe.

Agahora avyuka mu gitondo ca kare agahagarara i ruhande y’inzira ija kw’irembo ry’igisagara. Hagira umuntu aharengana afise ikimubabaje agiye kubaza i bwami, Abusalomu agaca amuhamagara ati: “Uva mu gisagara ikihe?” Na we akishura ati: “Umusavyi wawe ndi uwo mu muryango w’Abisirayeli uyu n’uyu.”
Maze Abusalomu agaca amubwira ati: “Ehe raba, ivyo uvuga birumvikana kandi uri mu kuri, ariko umwami nta muntu afise wo kubumviriza.”
Maze Abusalomu agaca yongerako ati: “Ese icari kumpa nkaba umucamanza muri iki gihugu! Umuntu wese afise ivyo arega canke ico apfa na mugenziwe yociye aza iwanje nanje nkamutunganiriza neza.”
Vyongeye, igihe cose umuntu yamwegera akamwunamira, Abusalomu yaca amufata ukuboko akamugumbira.
Abusalomu agakorera ivyo umuntu wese wo mu Bisirayeli agiye gusaba gutunganirizwa ku mwami, gutyo amera nk’uwutwaye imitima Abisirayeli bose, arayigarurira.
Haheze imyaka ine, Abusalomu abwira umwami ati: “Ndagusavye undekure ngende i Heburoni gushitsa isezerano nasezeraniye Uhoraho .
Igihe umusavyi wawe nari i Geshuri muri Siriya, nararahiye nti: Uhoraho niyansubiza i Yerusalemu, nzomushimirira i Heburoni.”
Umwami aravuga ati: “Genda amahoro.” Nuko aja i Heburoni.
Maze ari ngaho, Abusalomu aca arungika abantu mu mpisho mu miryango yose y’Abisirayeli kubabwira ngo: “Nimwumva inzamba zivuze, muce muvuga muti: ‘Abusalomu ni umwami yimikiwe i Heburoni.’ ”
Abusalomu yari yaherekejwe n’abantu amajana abiri kuva i Yerusalemu. Bari batumiwe nk’abatumire gusa, bagenda batazi na kimwe mu biriko birategurwa.

Igihe Abusalomu yariko aratanga ibimazi, atumako na Ahitofeli Umunyagiloni, umujenama wa Dawidi, ngo ave mu gisagara ca Gilo aho yaba aze. Nuko abifatanya na Abusalomu bakomeza kuba benshi kandi uwo mugambi wiwe ushishikara gukomera.
Haza umuntu i Yerusalemu azanye inkuru, abwira Dawidi ati: “Imitima y’Abisirayeli bose iri kumwe na Abusalomu mu nama yo kugukura.”

Nuko Dawidi abwira abishikira biwe bose bari kumwe na we i Yerusalemu ati: “Nimuze duhunge ahandi ho nta n’umwe muri twebwe akira inkota ya Abusalomu. Dutegerezwa kuva ngaha ubu nyene, kuko atari uko aradusanga hano aduteze ivyago vyinshi kandi yicishe inkota abari muri iki gisagara bose.”
Ba bishikira baramwishura bati: “Abasavyi bawe turiteguye gukora ico umwami ahitamwo cose.”
Umwami asohokana n’abo mu rugo rwiwe bose baramukurikira; ariko asiga incoreke icumi ngo zisigare ziritaho ikirimba.
Nuko Umwami aragenda, ari kumwe n’abantu bamukurikiye, bahagarara ku nzu ya nyuma y’igisagara.
Ingabo za Dawidi zose zica imbere yiwe, Abakereti n’Abapeleti bacungera ubuzima bw’umwami n’abandi amajana atandatu b’Abagati bari babanye na we kuva i Gati baja imbere yiwe.
Umwami abwira Itayi Umugati ati: “Ni kuki ujanye natwe? Isubirire inyuma ugumane n’umwami Abusalomu. Wewe uri inyambukira, wahunze uva mu gihugu c’iwanyu.
Waje ejobundi. None uwu musi ntume wangarana natwe, ko ntazi iyo ndiko ndaja? Subira inyuma, ujane n’ab’iwanyu bose. Ukugira neza n’ubwizigirwa vy’ Uhoraho bibane namwe.”
Ariko Itayi yishura umwami ati: “Ndahiye uguhoraho kw’ Uhoraho , ndahiye na wewe nyene umwami, aho umwami wanje azoba ni ho nanje nzoba, ari ugupfa canke ugukira.”
Dawidi abwira Itayi ati: “Ni vyiza hogi bandanya tugende.” Nuko Itayi Umugati aragenda ajana n’abantu bari kumwe na we n’imiryango bari kumwe.
Abantu bose bariko bararira baboroga babonye abantu babacako bagenda. Umwami na we nyene ajabuka umwonga wa Kidironi, kandi n’abantu bose bamukondorera inyuma bagenda berekeye mu bugaragwa.

Sadoki na we nyene n’Abalewi bose bari kumwe na we, bateruye Isandugu y’Isezerano y’Imana. Bashira ya Sandugu y’Imana ngaho, maze Abiyatari atanga ibimazi kugeza abantu bose bahejeje kuva mu gisagara.
Nuko umwami abwira Sadoki ati: “Subiza iyo Sandugu y’Imana mu gisagara. Uhoraho ninaba ndamuhimbaye, azongarukana ampe gusubira kuyibona n’ihema ryayo.
Ariko niyavuga ati: ‘ntukimpimbaye,’ na ho nyene nditeguye; nankorere ivyo abona ko bimbereye vyose.”

Umwami yongera kubwira Sadoki umuherezi ati: “Mbega wabitahuye? Subira mu gisagara amahoro mwe na Abiyatari n’umuhungu wawe Ahimazi hamwe na Yonatani mwene Abiyatari. Wewe na Abiyatari mujane n’abahungu banyu bompi.
Nanje, nzorindirira mu biyaya vyo kuri Yorodani aho ubugaragwa butangurira gushika aho nzoronkera amakuru mundungikiye.”
Nuko Sadoki na Abiyatari batwara ya Sandugu y’Imana i Yerusalemu baca bagumayo.

Ariko Dawidi wewe aguma agenda aduga Umusozi wa Elayono, agenda ararira ingenda; agenda yitwikiriye mu maso kandi ata birato yambaye. Abo bari kumwe na bo nyene bitwikira mu maso bagenda bararira uko baduga.
Ico gihe babwira Dawidi bati: “Ahitofeli na we nyene ari mu bagumutsi, ari kumwe na Abusalomu.” Maze Dawidi aca arasenga ati: “Yewe Uhoraho , hindura ubupfu inama ya Ahitofeli.”
Dawidi ashitse ku gatwe k’umusozi, aho abantu bahora basengera Imana, Hushayi Umwaruki ni ho yari aje kumusanganira, yitabaguriyeko impuzu, yisize ivu mu mutwe.
Dawidi amubwira ati: “Niwajana nanje, uzombera umuzigo.

Ariko niwasubira mu gisagara ukabwira Abusalomu uti: ‘Nzoba umusavyi wawe mwami; nk’uko nahora ndi umusavyi wa so muri kahise, ni ko n’ubu nzoba umusavyi wawe,’ aho ni ho uzomfasha kwica inama za Ahitofeli.
Mbega ntuzoba uri kumwe na Sadoki na Abiyatari abaherezi? Uzobabwire ivyo uzokwumva vyose ku kirimba c’umwami.
Abahungu babo babiri, Ahimazi mwene Sadoki na Yonatani mwene Abiyatari, bari kumwe na bo. Uzobandungikire baze kumbwira ivyo wumvise vyose.”
Nuko Hushayi umugenzi wa Dawidi ashika i Yerusalemu mu gihe Abusalomu yariko arinjira mu gisagara.

headings.text: Abusalomu agerageza gukura se ku ngoma

verses.text: Dawidi akiva kuri ka gatwe k’umusozi, ni ho Ziba, umusavyi wa Mefibosheti, yaza aje guhura na we. Yari ku ndogoba zibiri zikwega umukogote wiremetse imikate amajana abiri, udukate ijana ducumbwe mu nzabibu zumye, udukate ijana ducumbwe mu nsukoni n’umukuza w’urusato w’umuvinyu.

Umwami abaza Ziba ati: “Ivyo ni ivy’iki?” Ziba aramwishura ati: “Izi ndogoba ni iz’abo mu nzu y’umwami ngo bazigendereko, imikate na yo n’ivyamwa ni ivyokurya vy’ingabo, umuvinyu na wo ni uwo guhembura uwuzoba acitse intege mu bugaragwa.”
Nuko umwami arabaza ati: “Umwuzukuru wa shobuja we ari hehe?” Ziba aravuga ati: “Yagumye i Yerusalemu, kuko yiyumviriye ati: ‘Uyu musi inzu y’Abisirayeli iransubiza ubwami bwa sogokuru.’ ”
Maze umwami abwira Ziba ati: “Ivyari ivya Mefibosheti vyose bibaye ivyawe.” Ziba aravuga ati: “Ndaciye bugufi ndunamye. Nze name ngirirwa ubuntu imbere yawe, mwami nyaguhora ku ngoma.”
Umwami Dawidi yegereje gushika i Bahurimu, haza umuntu wo mu muryango wa Sawuli avuye muri ico gisagara. Izina ryiwe yitwa Shimeyi mwene Gera, agisohoka atangura kumuvuma.
Atera amabuye Dawidi n’abishikira biwe bari kumwe na we, naho hariho ingabo zigendera hirya no hino ya Dawidi.
Mu kumuvuma, Shimeyi yavuga ati: “Genda, genda, wa mwicanyi we, ata co umaze!
Uhoraho akwishuye amaraso yose washeshe y’abo mu nzu ya Sawuli, uwo wishize ku ngoma yiwe. Uhoraho ahaye ingoma yawe umuhungu wawe Abusalomu. Ubu ugiye mu magorwa kuko washeshe amaraso menshi.”
Maze Abishayi mwene Zeruwiya abwira umwami ati: “Ni iki gituma iyo mbwa ipfuye ituka umwami wanje? Reka ngende ndamuce umutwe.”
Ariko umwami amwishura ati: “Mbega ivyo bikurabako iki, ga mwana wa Zeruwiya? Nimba ariko arantuka kuko Uhoraho yabimutumye ati: ‘Tuka Dawidi,’ uri nde kugira ngo umubuze?”

Dawidi aca abwira Abishayi n’abishikira biwe bose ati: “Umwana wanje, akara kanje n’amaraso yanje ariko agerageza kunyica. None ntibirushirije cane kwumvikana, kuri uwu Mubenyamini? Mureke ashishikare antuke, kuko Uhoraho ari we yabimutumye.
Kumbure Uhoraho azobona umubabaro wanje anyishure ivyiza ku mivumo ndiko ndavumwa uwu musi.”
Nuko Dawidi n’abantu biwe bashishikara urugendo, maze Shimeyi agendera ku rundi ruhande rw’umusozi, aguma amuvuma amutera amabuye yongera asura inkungugu.
Umwami n’abari kumwe na bo bashika ku nkombe ya Yorodani barushe cane. Baca baruhukira aho.
Ico gihe Abusalomu yinjira i Yerusalemu n’Abisirayeli isinzi, kandi Ahitofeli yari kumwe na we.
Nuko Hushayi Umwaruki, umugenzi wa Dawidi, aja kwa Abusalomu amubwira ati: “Umwami nahangame! Umwami ahangame!”
Abusalomu abaza Hushayi ati: “Urwo ni rwo rukundo weretse umugenzi wawe? Ni kuki utajanye na we?”
Hushayi abwira Abusalomu ati: “Oyaye, uwatoranijwe n’ Uhoraho , n’aba bantu, n’Abisirayeli bose ni we nishikanyeko, kandi nzogumana na we.
Vyongeye, ni kuki ntogukorera? Mbega sinkwiye gukorera umuhungu nk’uko nakorera se? Ni ko na wewe nzogukorera.”
Abusalomu abwira Ahitofeli ati: “Tugire inama yawe. Dukore iki?”

Ahitofeli amwishura ati: “Ryamana n’incoreke za so abo yasigaranye ikirimba. Aho ni ho Abisirayeli bose bazokwumva ko wacokoye so ku rwego bitagishoboka ko mwiyuzuza, kandi abari ku ruhande rwawe bose bizoca bibatera intege bagushigikire bose.”
Nuko bubakira ihema Abusalomu hejuru ku kirimba, aca aryamana na za ncoreke za se Abisirayeli bose babibona.
Muri ico gihe inama yatangwa na Ahitofeli yaba ari nk’iyivuye ku Mana. Uko ni ko yaba Dawidi canke Abusalomu bafata impanuro bahawe na Ahitofeli.
Ahitofeli arongera abwira Abusalomu ati: “Nyemerera ntoranye ingabo ibihumbi cumi na bibiri maze iri joro nyene nje guhiga Dawidi iyo yagiye.
Ndamusanga akirushe acitse intege; we n’abo bari kumwe ndabaca ivutu, maze abari kumwe na we bose baca bamuta bahunge. Nica umwami wenyene,
nkugarukaneko abantu bose. Urupfu rw’uwo mugabo urondera rutuma abantu bose bagaruka; nawe uce uba amahoro.”
Iyo nama yasa n’aho ari nziza kuri Abusalomu, hamwe n’abakuru bose bo mu Bisirayeli.
Ariko Abusalomu avuga ati: “Tumako na Hushayi Umwaruki, kugira ngo twumve ivyo avuga.”
Maze Hushayi ashitse, Abusalomu avuga ati: “Ahitofeli yatugiriye iyi nama. Mbega dukore ivyo yatubwiye? Canke na ho wewe ubivugako iki?”
Hushayi yishura Abusalomu ati: “Impanuro Ahitofeli yatanze uno musi si nziza.
Urazi so n’abantu biwe bose ni abagwanyi, kandi ubu banganya ubukare n’idubu batwaye ivyana vyayo. Vyongeye, so ni umugwanyi yagwanye kuva kera; ntaza kurara hamwe n’ingabo ziwe.
Nk’ubu, usanga yinyegeje mw’isenga canke ahandi. Hamwe yotera ingabo zawe ubwa mbere akicamwo na bakeya, uwuzovyumva wese azovuga ati: ‘Hapfuye abantu mu ngabo zakurikiye Abusalomu.’
Maze n’umuhizi yari afise umutima urinda nk’uw’intambwe, azoca ashongeshwa n’ubwoba, kuko Abisirayeli bose bazi ko so ari umugwanyi kandi ko abari kumwe na we ari abahizi.
None rero nokugira iyi nama: reka Abisirayeli bose, kuva i Dani gushika i Berisheba bangana n’umusenyi wo ku kiyaga bakoranire aho uri wewe, hanyuma wewe ubwawe nyene ubaje imbere mu kuja mu rugamba.
Maze tuzomutera aho azoba ari hose, tumugweko nk’uko urume rugwa kw’isi. Nta n’umwe yaba we canke abari kumwe na we bazosigara.
Nibahungira mu gisagara kanaka, Abisirayeli bose bazoca bazana imigozi kuri ico gisagara, bagikwege bakijane mu kiyaya gushika aho ata n’ibuye rizoboneka risigaye rihagaze.”

Abusalomu n’abantu bose b’Abisirayeli baca bavuga bati: “Inama ya Hushayi Umwaruki ni nziza kuruta iya Ahitofeli.” Ivyo vyabaye kubera yuko Uhoraho yari yagabiye kuburabuza inama nziza ya Ahitofeli kugira ngo ateze ivyago Abusalomu.
Hushayi abwira Sadoki na Abiyatari abaherezi ati: “Ahitofeli yagiriye inama Abusalomu n’Abakuru b’Abisirayeli gukora gutya na gutya, ariko nabahanuye uku n’uku.
None rero rungika intumwa yo kubwira Dawidi iti: ‘Nturare mu kiyaya ca Yorodani mu bugaragwa; jabuka udatevye, bitari uko umwami n’abantu bari kumwe na we barahona.’ ”
Yonatani na Ahimazi bagumye ahitwa Eni-Rogeli. Hari umukobwa w’umugurano yari ashinzwe kubashira inkuru, na bo bagaca bagenda kubibwira umwami Dawidi, kuko batinjira mu gisagara kugira ntibababone.
Ariko umusore umwe arababona aca abibwira Abusalomu. Nuko bompi baca bagenda bihuta kwinyegeza mu nzu y’umuntu yaba i Bahurimu. Yari afise iriba riri mu rugo iwe, baca bamanuka muri ryo.
Umugore wiwe aca afata impuzu ayisasa hejuru y’iryo riba aca yanikirako ingano. Nta n’umwe yamenye ko aho hantu hariyo abantu.

Abantu ba Abusalomu barashika babaza wa mugore bati: “Ahimazi na Yonatani bari hehe?” Wa mugore arabishura ati: “Bajabutse umugezi.” Ba bantu bararondera ariko ntibabona n’umwe, baca basubira i Yerusalemu.

Abo bantu bamaze kugenda, ba bahungu babiri barurira bava muri iryo riba baca baja kubwira umwami Dawidi. Baramubwira bati: “Haguruka ujabuke Yorodani ubu nyene; Ahitofeli yabagiriye inama ivuga uku n’uku yo kukugwanya.”
Nuko Dawidi n’abari kumwe na we bose barahaguruka bajabuka Yorodani. Bwakeye ata n’umwe asigaye hakuno ya Yorodani.
Ahitofeli abonye ko inama yiwe itumviwe, aca ategura indogoba yiwe ataha iwe mu gisagara c’iwabo. Aca atunganya ivyo mu rugo rwiwe hanyuma ariyahura. Apfuye, bamuhamba hamwe na se.
Dawidi aja i Mahanayimu, Abusalomu na we ajabuka Yorodani n’Abisirayeli bose.

Abusalomu yari yatoye Amasa ngo abe umukuru w’ingabo mu kibanza ca Yowabu. Amasa yari umuhungu w’umugabo yitwa Yeteri, Umwisirayeli yari yarongoye Abigayili, umukobwa wa Nahashi kandi yavukana na Zeruwiya nyina wa Yowabu.
Abisirayeli na Abusalomu bacumbika mu gihugu c’i Gileyadi.
Dawidi ashitse i Mahanayimu, Shobi mwene Nahashi yava i Raba h’Abamoni, na Makiri mwene Amiyeli yava i Lo Debari, na Baruzilayi Umugileyadi yava i Rogelimu
bazana ivyo gusasa, n’amabesani n’ibibumvye mw’ibumba. Bazana n’ingano na sayiri, amafu n’ingano zikaranze, ibiharage n’ubushaza,
ubuki, amavuta avuye mu mikuku y’inka, amaforomaji y’inka vya Dawidi n’abantu biwe ngo bafungure. Kuko bavuze bati: “Abantu barashonje, bararushe kandi baranyotewe kubera ubugaragwa.”
Dawidi agendura ingabo ziri kumwe na we, ashiraho abagaba ingabo ijana n’abagaba igihumbi.

Dawidi atuma izo ngabo ku rugamba, ica gatatu c’izo ngabo catwarwa na Yowabu, ica gatatu kindi kigatwarwa na murumuna wa Yowabu, Abishayi mwene Zeruwiya, ikindi gice gisigaye kigatwarwa na Itayi Umugati. Umwami abwira ingabo ati: “Na jewe ubwanje ndajana namwe ku rugamba.”

Ariko abantu baravuga bati: “Ntujane natwe; nitwahunga nta n’umwe bigira ico bibwiye mu ngabo za Abusalomu. Mbere naho hopfa igice co muri twebwe nta co vyobabwira; ariko wewe wenyene ungana n’ibihumbi cumi ni wewe baza barondera gusa. Ni co gituma ukwiye gusigara mu gisagara, ukaturungikira abadutabara igihe vyoba bikenewe.”
Umwami arabishura ati: “Ndakora ibibahimbara vyose.” Nuko umwami ahagarara i ruhande y’irembo igihe ingabo zariko zirasohoka ziri mu mice y’ijanajana n’igihumbihumbi.

Umwami ategeka Yowabu, Abishayi na Itayi ati: “Ndabinginze, mwitondere uwo muhungu Abusalomu, mubikore ku bwanje.” Kandi ingabo zose zarumva aho Umwami yatanga iryo tegeko ryerekeye Abusalomu ariha umukuru wese.
Ingabo za Dawidi zija ku rugamba kugwanya Abisirayeli, maze intambara ibera mw’ishamba ry’Abefurayimu.
Ingabo z’Abisirayeli zineshwa n’abantu ba Dawidi, kandi hapfa abantu benshi cane ibihumbi mirongo ibiri.
Intambara ikwira mu gihugu cose, kandi abishwe n’ishamba baba benshi kuruta abishwe n’inkota.

Maze abusalomu ahura n’abantu ba Dawidi. Yari ku nyumbu yiwe, hanyuma agerageje guhunga, iyo nyumbu ica musi y’amashami azitanye y’igiti kinini, umushatsi wa Abusalomu ufatwa na ya mashami y’igiti, aguma yenena mu kirere, ariko inyumbu yariko iguma yigira.
Umwe muri ba bantu ba Dawidi abibonye, abwira Yowabu ati: “Nabonye Abusalomu yenena ku giti.”
Yowabu abwira uwo muntu amubwiye ivyo ati: “Wamubonye? None ni iki catumye utamwica ngo agwe aho nyene? Naca ndaguha shekeli icumi z’ifeza n’umukanda w’abahizi ku rugamba.”

Ariko uwo muntu aramwishura ati: “Naho shekeli igihumbi zari kuba zaharuwe ziri mu ntoke zanje, sinari gukoza ukuboko ku mwana w’umwami. Twavyiyumviye yuko umwami yategetse wewe na Abishayi na Itayi ati: ‘Mwitondere uwo muhungu Abusalomu ku bwanje.’
Iyo mba namwishe nari kuba nigiriye nabi ubwanje, kuko umwami yoruhiye kubimenya nawe ukanyigarama.”
Yowabu aravuga ati: “Singomba guta umwanya ngo ndiko ndavugana nawe.” Nuko yakira amacumu atatu mu ntoke ariruka asanga Abusalomu acenena kuri ca giti kandi akiri muzima, ayamutera mu mutima.
Maze ba basoda cumi batwaza ibigwanisho Yowabu bakikiza Abusalomu, bamucumitira aho nyene arapfa.
Nuko Yowabu aca avuza inzamba, ingabo ziwe zireka gukurikira Abisirayeli, kuko yari abahagaritse.
Bafata Abusalomu baja kumuta mu kinogo kirekire kiri mw’ishamba, baca bakirenzako ibibuye bininibinini. Muri uwo mwanya Abisirayeli bari bahunze, umuntu wese aja iwe.

Akiriho, Abusalomu yari yarashinze inkingi y’icibutso ciwe mu kiyaya c’umwami, kuko yiyumviriye ati: “Nta muhungu mfise ngo aze yibutse izina ryanje.” Aca yita iyo nkingi izina ryiwe, n’uwu musi iracitwa Icibutso ca Abusalomu.
Nuko Ahimazi mwene Sadoki aravuga ati: “Nyemerera niruke menyeshe iyi nkuru umwami ko Uhoraho amukuye mu maboko y’abansi biwe.”
Yowabu aramubwira ati: “Reka, si wewe wo kumenyesha iyo nkuru uwu musi. Nshobora kuzogutuma kumenyesha inkuru uwundi musi, ariko uwu musi ntubikore, kuko umuhungu w’umwami yapfuye.”
Maze Yowabu abwira Umunyakushi ati: “Genda ubwire umwami ivyo wabonye.” Wa Munyakushi yunama imbere ya Yowabu aca ariruka.

Ahimazi mwene Sadoki yongera kubwira Yowabu ati: “Ukwo vyogenda kwose, ndakwinginze ndeka nanje nkurikire uwu Munyakushi.” Ariko Yowabu arishura ati: “Muhungu wanje, ni kuki ugomba kugenda? Nta nkuru ufise yotuma uronka ingero.”
Aravuga ati: “Egome, ariko nyemerera, nshaka kugenda.” Nuko Yowabu aravuga ati: “Iruka!” Maze Ahimazi ariruka aca mu kiyaya asiga wa Munyakushi.
Dawidi acicaye hagati y’ibikingi vy’irembo, umurinzi aduga hejuru ku nzu, ku muryango w’irembo. Aravye, abona umuntu yiruka ari wenyene.
Wa murinzi ahamagara umwami arabimubwira. Umwami aravuga ati: “Ko ari wenyene, ashobora kuba azanye inkuru nziza.” Wa muntu aguma yegereza.
Wa murinzi abona uwundi aje yiruka, aca ahamagara umurinzi w’irembo ati: “Ehe uwundi aje yiruka ari wenyene!” Umwami aravuga ati: “Na we nyene ashobora kuba azanye inkuru nziza.”
Wa murinzi aravuga ati: “Umengo umwe wa mbere yiruka nka Ahimazi mwene Sadoki.” Umwami ati: “Ni umuntu mwiza. Azanye inkuru nziza.”

Maze Ahimazi ahamagara umwami ati: “Vyose ni vyiza!” Yunama imbere y’umwami akoza umutwe hasi aca aravuga ati: “ Uhoraho Imana yawe ahimbazwe! Kuko yagabuye abantu bahagurukiye kugwanya umwami wanje.”
Umwami arabaza ati: “Wa muhungu Abusalomu ariho?” Ahimazi arishura ati: “Igihe Yowabu yandungika ivyariko biraba ntivyari bwasobanuke neza, sinamenye ivyo ari vyo.”
Umwami aravuga ati: “Hagarara i ruhande urindirire aha.” Nuko aja i ruhande ahagararaho.
Wa Munyakushi arashika aca aravuga ati: “Mwami nyeningoma, niwumve inkuru nziza! Uhoraho yagutabaye agukura mu maboko y’abari baguhagurukiye.”
Umwami abaza wa Munyakushi ati: “Wa muhungu Abusalomu nta co yabaye?” Wa Munyakushi arishura ati: “Abansi b’umwami wanje n’abomuhagurukira bose ngo bamugirire nabi barakaba nk’uko uwo musore yabaye.”

Umwami aca aracika intege. Aca aja mu cumba co hejuru cari ku muryango w’igisagara aririrayo. Agenda aravuga ati: “Ewe mwana wanje Abusalomu! Mwana wanje, mwana wanje Abusalomu! Iyo mpfuma aba ari jewe mpfa hako wewe upfa; yewe Abusalomu, mwana wanje, mwana wanje!”
Maze babwira Yowabu bati: “Umwami ariko ararira aborogera Abusalomu.”
Kandi ingabo zose zumvise umubabaro w’umwami intsinzi bari baronse uwo musi ihinduka ikigandaro, kuko kuri uwo musi ingabo zari zumvise bavuga bati: “Umwami ababajwe n’umwana wiwe.”
Ingabo zinjira mu gisagara nk’abiyiba nk’uko ingabo zomboka mu kwinjira kubera ibimaramare igihe bahunze mu ntambara.
Umwami yipfuka mu maso araboroga cane ati: “Ewe mwana wanje Abusalomu! Ewe Abusalomu, mwana wanje, mwana wanje!”
Nuko Yowabu yinjira mu nzu aho umwami ari amubwira ati: “Uyu musi utetereje ingabo zose, zagukirije ubuzima n’ubw’abahungu bawe n’ubw’abakobwa bawe n’ubuzima bw’abagore bawe n’incoreke zawe.
Ukunda abakwanka ukanka abagukunda. Uyu musi uravyerekanye ko abakuru b’ingabo n’ingabo zose ata co bavuze imbere yawe. Ndabona ko wari kunezerwa iyo Abusalomu aba akiriho natwe twese twapfuye.

Nuko rero sohoka uremeshe ingabo. Ndahiye uguhoraho kw’ Uhoraho ko nimba udasohotse, nta n’umwe aja gusigara ari inyuma yawe uwu musi. Kandi ivyo biraja kukubera bibi kurusha ivyago vyose vyakubayeko kuva mu buto bwawe gushika uwu musi.”

Maze umwami arahaguruka avyagira ku ntebe yiwe yari kw’irembo. Babwira abantu bati: “Umwami avyagiye kw’irembo.” Bose baca bakoranira imbere yiwe. Muri ico gihe Abisirayeli bose bari kumwe na Abusalomu, bari bahunze umwe wese aja iwe.

Mu miryango yose y’Abisirayeli, abantu bariko baraharira bavuga bati: “Umwami yatubohoye adukura mu maboko y’abansi bacu; ni we yadukijije ukuboko kw’Abafilisitiya. Ariko ehe raba ubu yarahunze igihugu kubera Abusalomu;
kandi Abusalomu twari twasize amavuta ngo abe umwami wacu, yaguye ku rugamba. None ko ata co muvuga ku vyerekeye kugarukana umwami?”

Umwami Dawidi arungika ubu butumwa kuri Sadoki na Abiyatari abaherezi ngo: “Mubaze abakurambere b’Abayuda muti: ‘Ni kuki mwoba abanyuma mu kugarukana umwami mu kirimba iwe, ko ibiriko biravugwa mu Bisirayeli bose vyashikiriye umwami aho ari?
Muri abavukanyi banje, akara kamwe n’amaraso amwe nanje. None ni igiki cotuma muba abanyuma kugarukana umwami?’
Kandi mubwire Amasa muti: ‘Mbega nturi akara kamwe n’amaraso amwe na we? Imana ize ibimpore, kandi birushirije, nutaba umukuru w’ingabo ziwe mu gishingo ca Yowabu.’ ”
Amajambo ya Dawidi yigarurira imitima y’Abayuda bose baca baba nk’umuntu umwe. Batumako umwami bati: “Garuka mwe n’abantu bawe bose.”
Umwami aca aragaruka ashika ku nkombe za Yorodani. Abayuda bari baje i Gilugali kugira ngo basanganire umwami bamujabutse Yorodani.
Shimeyi mwene Gera, Umubenyamini yaba i Bahurimu, arihuta amanukana n’Abayuda gusanganira umwami Dawidi.
Yari kumwe n’Ababenyamini igihumbi, hamwe na Ziba umuzezwabintu wo mu nzu ya Sawuli, n’abahungu biwe icumi na batanu n’abagurano mirongo ibiri. Baranyaruka baja kuri Yorodani, aho umwami yari ageze.
Baca barihuta kujabuka ngo baje kujabukana ab’inzu y’umwami no gukora ico yogomba cose. Shimeyi mwene Gera ajabutse Yorodani, aca yikubita hasi yubama imbere y’umwami
aramubwira ati: “Icompa umwami ntamparureko icaha canje. Ntiwibuke ivyo umusavyi wawe nagucumuyeko igihe umwami wanje yava i Yerusalemu. Icompa umwami akavyirengagiza.
Kuko jewe umusavyi wawe nzi ko nacumuye, ariko uwu musi nabaye uwa mbere mu b’inzu ya Yosefu kumanuka gusanganira umwami wanje.”
Maze Abishayi mwene Zeruwiya aravuga ati: “Shimeyi akwiye kwicwa, kubera yavumye uwo Uhoraho yimikishije amavuta.”
Dawidi aramwishura ati: “Ivyo bibatwaye iki ga bene Zeruwiya? Ni kuki mumbereye nk’abangwanya? Mbega hari uwokwicwa uwu musi mu Bisirayeli? Mbega sinzi ko uwu musi ndi umwami w’Abisirayeli?”
Nuko umwami abwira Shimeyi ati: “Ntugipfuye.” Maze umwami aramurahira.

Mefibosheti, umwuzukuru wa Sawuli, na we nyene aramanuka gusanganira umwami. Kuva umusi umwami yaviriye i Yerusalemu n’umusi yagarukiyeko amahoro, ntiyari bwakure ubwanwa canke ngo yoge ibirenge canke ngo amesure impuzu ziwe.
Igihe yava i Yerusalemu aja gusanganira umwami, umwami aramubaza ati: “Ni kuki utajanye nanje, ga Mefibosheti?”
Amwishura ati: “Mwami nyeningoma, kuko umusavyi wawe mugaye, nabwiye Ziba nti: ‘Ntegurira indogoba kugira ngo njane n’umwami.’ Ariko Ziba umugurano wanje yarambeshe.
Yaranambesheye jewe umusavyi wawe ku mwami wanje avuga ko nanse kuza. Ariko, wewe mwami wanje uri nk’umumarayika w’Imana; nuko rero nukore ikiguhimbaye cose.
Abo mu muryango wa sogokuru nta kindi bari bakwiye atari urupfu mu nyonga zawe, ariko wahaye umusavyi wawe ikibanza ku meza yawe. Mbega hari ikindi nosaba imbere y’umwami wanje?”
Umwami aramubwira ati: “Ni kuki uvuga vyinshi? Ntegetse ko wewe na Ziba mugabura imirima.”
Mefibosheti abwira umwami ati: “Mureke atware vyose, igikuru ni uko umwami wanje agarutse amahoro.”
Baruzilayi Umugileyadi na we aramanuka avuye i Rogelimu ngo ajabukane Yorodani n’umwami anamuherekeze asubiye iwe.
Uwo Baruzilayi yari ashaje cane, afise imyaka mirongo umunani. Ni we yagaburiye umwami igihe yari i Mahanayimu, kuko yari umutunzi cane.
Umwami abwira Baruzilayi ati: “Jabukana nanje uce ugumana nanje i Yerusalemu, nanje nzoguha ibikwiye vyose.”
Ariko Baruzilayi arishura ati: “Mbega nsigaje imyaka ingahe yo kubaho, ku buryo nodugana nawe ga mwami i Yerusalemu?

Ubu maze imyaka mirongo umunani. Mbega ndacatandukanya ikibi n’iciza? Mbega umusavyi wawe ndacamenya ibiryoshe n’ibibishe vyaba ivyokurya canke ivyo kunywa? Ndacumva amajwi y’abaririmvyi baba abagabo canke abagore? None ni igiki cotuma jewe umusavyi wawe ndakubera umutwaro ga mwami wanje nyeningoma?
Umusavyi wawe ndajabukana Yorodani nawe ndaguherekeze gatoya, ariko ni iki cotuma umwami ampa impembo ingana ityo?

Reka umusavyi wawe nisubirire inyuma, kugira ngo nze mpfire mu gisagara c’iwacu mpambwe i ruhande y’imva za data na mama. Ariko ng’uwu umusavyi wawe Kimuhamu. Reka ajabukane nawe mwami. Uze umukorere ibiguhimbaye vyose.”
Umwami aravuga ati: “Kimuhamu arajabukana nanje, kandi nzomukorera ivyo ushaka vyose. Ivyo wipfuza vyose, nzobikora ku bwawe.”
Nuko abantu bose bajabuka Yorodani, maze n’umwami arajabuka. Umwami agumbira Baruzilayi aramuhezagira, maze Baruzilayi asubira iwe.
Umwami amaze kujabuka hakurya i Gilugali, Kimuhami ajabukana na we. Ingabo zose z’Abayuda n’igice c’ingabo z’Abisirayeli baherekeza umwami.
