Maze abantu bose b’Abisirayeli baza aho umwami ari, bitwarira abo mu muryango wa Yuda bati: “Ni kuki abavukanyi bacu b’Abayuda, batwivye umwami bakongera bakamujabukana Yorodani bamugarukanye hamwe n’ab’inzu yiwe bose, n’ingabo zose za Dawidi zari kumwe na we bonyene?”

Abantu bose b’Abayuda bishura Abisirayeli bati: “Twabikoze kuko umwami ari uwo mu muryango wacu wa hafi. None ni kuki bibashavuje? Hari ivyokurya vy’umwami twariye twenyene? Mbega hari ikintu na kimwe twatwaye ciwe ngo tukigire icacu?”

Nuko ingabo z’Abisirayeli zishura ingabo z’Abayuda ziti: “Dufise imigabane icumi ku mwami; kandi i ruhande y’ivyo, muri Dawidi dufise vyinshi kubarusha. None ni iki gituma mudukengera? Ntituri aba mbere batanguye kuvuga ivyo kugarukana umwami wacu?” Ariko abantu b’i Buyuda bishurana amajambo akaze kurusha Abisirayeli.

I Gilugali hari umuntu w’imburakimazi yitwa Sheba mwene Bikuri, Umubenyamini. Avuza inzamba arasemerera ati: “Nta mugabane dufise kuri Dawidi, nta mugabane kuri mwene Isayi! Yemwe Bisirayeli, umuntu wese niyigire iwe!”
Nuko Abisirayeli bava inyuma ya Dawidi bakurikira Sheba mwene Bikuri. Ariko Abayuda baguma inyuma y’umwami wabo kuva kuri Yorodani gushika i Yerusalemu.

Dawidi asubiye ku kirimba iwe i Yerusalemu, afata za ncoreke icumi yari yasize ngo basigarane ikirimba abashira mu nzu barindirwamwo. Abategekaniriza ivyo bakeneye vyose, ariko ntiyasubira kuryamana na bo. Barindirwa ngaho gushika bapfuye, babaho nk’abapfakazi.
Nuko umwami abwira Amasa ati: “Tumako abantu b’i Buyuda baze aho ndi bitarenze imisi itatu, kandi nawe ubwawe uzobe ari ho uri.”
Ariko Amasa agiye guhamagara Abayuda, amarayo umwanya munini uruta uwo umwami yari yamuhaye.

Dawidi abwira Abishayi ati: “Ubu Sheba mwene Bikuri azotugirira ibibi biruta ivyo Abusalomu yatugiriye. Jana n’abantu ba shobuja umukurikire, kugira ngo ntahave yinjira mu bisagara bizitijwe inzitiro akadusiga.”
Nuko ingabo za Yowabu n’Abakereti n’Abapeleti n’abahizi bose barasohoka barongowe na Abishayi. Bava i Yerusalemu bakurikira Sheba mwene Bikuri.

Bakiri ku gitandara kinini c’i Gibeyoni, Amasa aza kubasanganira. Yowabu yari yambaye umwambaro wiwe w’intambara arenzako umukanda kw’itako ashirako n’inkota iri mu rwubati rwayo. Maze ariko aragenda kuramutsa Amasa amera nk’usokora inkota yiwe, iva mu rwubati.
Yowabu abwira Amasa ati: “Amakuru maki ga muvukanyi?” Nuko Yowabu afata Amasa ku bwanwa n’ukuboko kwiwe kw’i buryo aramugumbira.

Amasa ntiyari yabonye ko Yowabu yafatishije inkota ukuboko kw’i bubamfu, maze Yowabu aca ayimucumita mu nda amara yiwe aseseka hasi. Ubwo nyene Amasa aca aracikana, Yowabu atiriwe arongera kumucumita. Yowabu n’umuvukanyi wiwe Abishayi baca babandanya gukurikira Sheba mwene Bikuri.
Umwe nu ngabo zari kumwe na Yowabu ahagarara i ruhande ya Amasa abwira ingabo za Amasa ati: “Uwukunda Yowabu wese, uwuri ku ruhande rwa Dawidi wese, nakurikire Yowabu!”
Amasa we yari arambaraye mu bitenga vy’amaraso yiwe mu nzira, maze wa muntu abonye ko ingabo zose zihagera zigahagarara, aca akwega umuvyimba awukura mu nzira awushira mu mirima awurenzako impuzu.
Amasa amaze gukurwa mu nzira, ingabo zose zijana na Yowabu bakurikira Sheba mwene Bikuri.
Sheba aca mu miryango y’Abisirayeli yose mbere ashika n’i Abeli-Beti-Mayaka no mu ntara yose y’Ababikiriti, baca barakorana bamuja inyuma.

Ingabo zose zari kumwe na Yowabu zishitse basugereza Sheba ari mu gisagara c’i Abeli-Beti-Mayaka. Baca barunda ikirundo c’ivu cegamiye ku ruhande rw’inyuma y’uruzitiro. Bakiriko barabomora urwo ruzitiro ngo barusenyure,
umugore umwe w’umunyabwenge ahamagara ari mu gisagara ati: “Umviriza! Umviriza! Mbwirira Yowabu aze hano ico ndamubwira.”
Na we aja iyo ari, na we aramubaza ati: “Ni wewe Yowabu?” Aramwishura ati: “Ni jewe.” Wa mugore amubwira ati: “Umviriza ico umusavyikazi wawe ngomba kukubwira.” Amwishura ati: “Ndaguteze amatwi.”
Wa mugore arabandanya ati: “Kera bahora bavuga bati, ‘ugomba kumara ibihari, baza abo mu gisagara Abeli,’ kandi ni ko bakora.
Ndi umunyamahoro n’umwizigirwa muri Isirayeli. Ariko muriko mugerageza gusenyura igisagara gihambaye muri Isirayeli. None ni iki gituma mugomba kuyongobeza umugabane w’ Uhoraho ?”
Yowabu aramwishura ati: “Ntibikabe ko norota nsambura igisagara canyu!

Iyo si yo ntumbero. Umuntu yitwa Sheba mwene Bikuri, ava mu misozi y’Abefurayimu, yahagurukiye kugwanya umwami Dawidi. Nimuduhe uwo mugabo, natwe duca tuva muri iki gisagara.” Wa mugore abwira Yowabu ati: “Umutwe wiwe barawuguterera bawucishije hejuru y’uruzitiro.”

Nuko wa mugore w’umunyabwenge aja ku bantu b’iwabo ajanye inama yiwe y’ubwenge, baca bafata Sheba mwene Bikuri bamuca umutwe bawuterera Yowabu. Nuko aca avuza inzamba, abantu biwe baca bava muri ico gisagara, umwe wese yitahira iwe. Yowabu na we aca asubira i bwami i Yerusalemu.
Yowabu ni we yatwara ingabo zose z’Abisirayeli; Benaya mwene Yehoyada ni we yatwara Abakereti n’Abapeleti;
Adoramu yari ajejwe abakozi bo ku bikebere; Yehoshafati mwene Ahiludi yari umwanditsi w’ivyaja biraba;
Sheva yari umwanditsi; Sadoki na Abiyatari bari abaherezi;
maze Ira Umuyayiri na we yari umuherezi wa Dawidi.

Ku ngoma ya Dawidi, haba inzara imara imyaka itatu yikurikiranya; maze Dawidi arondera mu nyonga h’ Uhoraho . Uhoraho aravuga ati: “Ni kubera Sawuli n’inzu yiwe basheshe amaraso, mu kwica Abagibeyoni.”

Umwami ahamagaza Abagibeyoni avugana na bo. (Abo Bagibeyoni ntibari Abisirayeli ariko bari amasigarira y’Abamori. Abisirayeli bari barabarahiye ko batazobica, ariko Sawuli kubera ishaka yari afitiye Abisirayeli n’Abayuda yagerageje kubahonya bose.)
Dawidi abaza Abagibeyoni ati: “Nobakorera iki? Nokosora gute amakosa yakozwe kugira ngo muhezagire umugabane w’ Uhoraho ?”

Abagibeyoni baramwishura bati: “Ifeza canke inzahabu ntizokuraho iyo ngorane hagati yacu n’umuryango wa Sawuli kandi nta burenganzira dufise bwo kwica umuntu n’umwe mu Bisirayeli.” Dawidi arababaza ati: “None mugomba ko ndabakorera iki?”
Bishura umwami bati: “Sawuli yagomba kuduherengeteza ngo ntihasigare n’umwe kandi ntihabe hakiri ahantu na hamwe turangwa mu Bwisirayeli hose.
None duhe abagabo indwi bo mu bamukomokako, tubice tubarambike imbere y’ Uhoraho i Gibeya h’i Sawuli, ku musozi watoranijwe n’ Uhoraho .” Nuko umwami aravuga ati: “Ndababaha.”
Umwami akingira Mefibosheti mwene Yonatani, Yonatani mwene Sawuli, ku bwa ya ndahiro Dawidi yarahira Yonatani imbere y’ Uhoraho .

Ariko umwami atanga abahungu babiri ba Sawuli ari bo Arumoni na Mefibosheti, yavyaranye na Rizipa umukobwa wa Ayiya hamwe n’abahungu batanu ba Merabu umukobwa wa Sawuli, abo yari yavyaranye na Adiriyeli mwene Baruzilayi Umumeholati.
Abaha Abagibeyoni, na bo barabica babarambika imbere y’ Uhoraho . Abo uko bari indwi bapfira rimwe; bishwe mu misi ya mbere y’iyimbura, bagitangura kwimbura sayiri.

Rizipa umukobwa wa Ayiya afata amagunira ayubakamwo urusago ku gitandara. Kuva mu ntango z’ukwimbura gushika imvura ikorotse kuri ya mivyimba, ntiyemerera inyoni zo mu kirere kuyikorako ku murango canke ibikoko vyo mw’ishamba mw’ijoro.
Dawidi yumvise ivyo Rizipa umukobwa wa Ayiya akaba kandi incoreke ya Sawuli yakoze,

aragenda aja gusaba ab’i Yabeshi Gileyadi amagufa ya Sawuli na Yonatani. (Igihe Abafilisitiya bica Sawuli na Yonatani ku musozi Gilibowa, abantu b’i Yabeshi Gileyadi bagiye binyegeje bafata imivyimba yabo, bayikura ku mbuga y’ikoraniro i Beti-Shani aho Abafilisitiya babamanitse.)
Dawidi akurayo amagufa ya Sawuli n’umuhungu wiwe Yonatani, hamwe n’aya ba bantu indwi bishwe kandi bakanikirwa n’Abagibeyoni.

Bahamba ya magufa ya Sawuli n’umuhungu wiwe Yonatani mu mva ya Kishi se wa Sawuli, yari i Zela mu Bubenyamini, kandi bakora ivyo umwami yategetse vyose. Inyuma y’ivyo, Imana yishura amasengesho basengeye igihugu.
Haba iyindi ntambara hagati y’Abafilisitiya n’Abisirayeli. Dawidi amanukana n’abantu biwe kugwanya Abafilisitiya, maze araruha.
Kandi Ishubi Benobi, umwe mu bo mu ruvyaro rwa Rafa, icumu ryiwe ryapima shekeli amajana atatu kandi yari yambaye inkota nshasha. Yari asugereje Dawidi agomba kumwica.

Ariko Abishayi mwene Zeruwiya aza gutabara Dawidi; yica uwo Mufilisitiya. Maze abantu ba Dawidi bararahira umwami, bavuga bati: “Ntuzosubira na rimwe kujana natwe mu ntambara, kugira ngo itara rya Isirayeli ntirizime.”
Hanyuma y’ivyo, haba iyindi ntambara n’Abafilisitiya ibera i Gobu. Muri ico gihe Sibekayi Umuhushati yica Safi, umwe wo mu ruvyaro rwa Rafa.
Mu yindi ntambara yabereye i Gobu bagwanya Abafilisitiya, Eluhanani mwene Yayare-Oregimu w’i Betelehemu yica mwenewabo wa Goliyati w’i Gati, uruti rw’icumu ryiwe rwangana n’umuhini.

Kandi mu yindi ntambara yabereye i Gati, hari umugabo munini cane yari afise intoke zitandatu ku kiganza cose n’amano atandatu ku kirenge cose; vyose hamwe vyari mirongo ibiri na bine. Na we nyene yakomoka kuri Rafa.
Atanguye gucokora Abisirayeli, Yonatani mwene Shimeya, yavukana na Dawidi, aramwica.
Abo bose uko ari bane bakomoka kuri Rafa w’i Gati, maze bicwa na Dawidi n’abantu biwe.

headings.text: Abo mu ruvyaro rwa Sawuli bicwa

verses.text: Dawidi aririmbira Uhoraho muri aya majambo amaze kumukiza abansi biwe bose, no kumukura mu maboko ya Sawuli.
Aravuga ati: “ Uhoraho ni igitandara canje, igihome canje kinkingira n’umutabazi wanje;
Imana yanje ni igitandara canje nihishamwo, inkinzo yanje n’ihembe ry’agakiza kanje. Ni we buhungiro bwanje, ubwihisho bwanje n’umukiza wanje, ankiza abantu b’inkozi z’ikibi.
Nambaje Uhoraho , we abereye gushimwa, na we ankiza abansi banje.
Imipfunda y’urupfu yaransugereje; imikuba y’ukurandura yarandengeye.
Iminyororo y’i kuzimu yaranyizingiriyeko; imitego y’urupfu yarantangiriye.
Mu mubabaro wanje nambaje Uhoraho ; nambaje Imana yanje. Iri mu ngoro yayo yumvise ijwi ryanje; ugutakamba kwanje gushika mu matwi yayo.
Isi yaratigise ihinda agashitsi, amatanguriro y’amajuru aranyiganyiga; yahinze agashitsi kuko Uhoraho yari yaratse.
Umwotsi wapfunduka mu mazuru yiwe; umuriro utongora wava mu kanwa kiwe, hamwe n’amakara yaka.
Yamenye ijuru aramanuka; ibicu vyirabura vyari musi y’ibirenge vyiwe.
Yaje aguruka ku mukerubi; aboneka agendera ku mababa y’umuyaga.
Yipfutse umwijima nk’ihema rimukikuje; ibicu vyirabura vyo kw’ijuru vyuzuye imvura.
Mu gukayangana kwo mu nyonga hiwe, havamwo imiravyo imeze nk’imbeya z’umuriro.
Uhoraho yaraturagaye ari mw’ijuru; ijwi ry’Iyisumbavyose ryarasamiranye.
Yarashe imyampi isanzaza abansi, imbeya z’umuriro zarabakinagije.
Ibiyaya vyo mu kiyaga vyagiye ahabona n’amatanguriro y’isi aragaragara ku bw’ugukankama kw’ Uhoraho , no ku bw’impwemu ziva mu mazuru yiwe.
Yagoroye ukuboko kwiwe ari iyo hejuru aramfata; ankura mu mazi menshi.
Yantabaye umwansi wanje akomeye, ankiza abanyanka, bandusha inkomezi.
Banteye ku musi w’ivyago vyanje, ariko Uhoraho ni we yanshigikiye.
Yaransohoye anjana ahagutse; arankiza kuko yanezererewe.
Uhoraho yankoreye ibihwanye n’ukugororoka kwanje; yampaye ingero ikwiranye n’ugutungana kw’amaboko yanje.
Kuko nagumye mu nzira z’ Uhoraho ; sinigeze ncumura ngo mve ku Mana yanje.
Ivyagezwe vyiwe vyose biri imbere yanje; sinigeze mpindukira ngo mve mu vyo yihanikirije.
Namye ntagira umugayo imbere yiwe kandi nirinze icaha.
Uhoraho yanyishuye ibikwiranye n’ukugororoka kwanje, ibihwanye n’ugutungana kwanje mu nyonga hiwe.
Ku mwizigirwa wiyerekana uri umwizigirwa, ku wutagira umugayo wiyerekana uri uwutagira umugayo,
ku wutunganye wiyerekana uri uwutunganye, ariko ku muntu w’intabarirwa wiyerekana nk’uwutagira akagongwe.
Ukiza abaciye bugufi, ariko inyonga zawe ziri ku bibone ngo ubacishe bugufi.
Ewe Uhoraho , uri itara ryanje; Uhoraho ahindura umwijima wanje ukaba umuco.
Ku bwawe, nshobora gutera ingabo nyinshi; turi kumwe n’Imana yanje, nshobora kwurira uruzitiro.
Imana yo, inzira yayo iratunganye: ijambo ry’ Uhoraho ni iry’ukuri; abera inkinzo abamuhungirako bose.
None ni nde Mana atari Uhoraho ? Kandi ni nde Gitandara atari Imana yacu?
Imana ni yo buhungiro bwanje, igorora inzira yanje.
Ihindura ibirenge vyanje nk’ivy’impongo; ikanshoboza guhagarara ku dutwe tw’imisozi.
Yigisha iminwe yanje kugwana; agashoboza amaboko yanje gufora umuheto w’umwakaka.
Agakiza kawe kabaye inkinzo yanje, ubushobozi bwawe ni bwo bwangize uwuhambaye.
Wanteguriye inzira ncamwo yagutse, kugira ngo ibirenge vyanje ntibinyerere.
Nakurikiye abansi banje ndabanesha; sinasubiye inyuma badaherengeteye.
Nabagize ubunywenywe, nta n’uwushobora kuvyura umutwe; baguye musi y’ibirenge vyanje.
Wanyambitse inkomezi zo kugwana; wacishije bugufi abansi banje imbere yanje.
Watumye abansi banje bata barahunga, kandi wampaye kubaherengeteza.
Baratakamvye, habura uwubakiza; batakambiye Uhoraho , ariko ntiyabishura.
Maze ndabasya nk’umukungugu wo hasi; ndabahonyanga, ndabasiribanga nk’ivyondo mu nzira y’abahita.
Wankijije ibitero vy’abantu; unzigamira ingoma ngo nganze amahanga. Abantu ntigeze kumenya ubu ni bo bankorera,
abanyamahanga baranyunamira; uko bumvise ijwi ryanje, baranyumvira.
Bose bacika intege; bava aho bari binyegeje bahinda agashitsi.
Uhoraho ni muzima! Hahimbazwe igitandara canje! Hashirwe hejuru Imana yo gitandara c’agakiza kanje!
Ni we Mana imporera, igashira amahanga musi yanje,
ikankiza abansi banje. Wanshize hejuru y’abangwanya; untabara abantu b’inkozi z’ikibi.
Ni co gituma nzoguhimbaza, ewe Uhoraho , mu mahanga; nzotazira izina ryawe.
Ni we aha umwami wiwe intsinzi zihambaye; yerekanye urukundo rudashira ku wo yarobanuje amavuta, ari we Dawidi n’uruvyaro rwiwe.”
Aya ni yo majambo ya nyuma ya Dawidi: “Uku ni ko Dawidi mwene Isayi avuga, uwashizwe hejuru n’Iyisumbavyose, umuntu yasizwe amavuta n’Imana ya Yakobo, umuririmvyi aririmba indirimbo ya Isirayeli.
Mpwemu w’ Uhoraho yavugiye muri jewe; ijambo ryiwe ryari ku rurimi rwanje.
Imana y’Abisirayeli yaravuze, gitandara c’Abisirayeli yarambwiye ati: ‘Uwuganza abantu mu bugororotsi, igihe aganza yubaha Imana,
aba ameze nk’umuco wo mu gitondo igihe izuba riserutse mu gitondo kitagira ibicu, nk’ugukayangana kw’ijuru inyuma y’imvura kumwe gutuma ivyatsi bimera biva mw’ivu.’
Mbega inzu yanje ntiri amahoro ku Mana? Ntiyagiranye nanje isezerano rihoraho, ryashizweho rigakomezwa impande zose? Mbega ntizoshitsa ivy’agakiza kanje igashitsa n’ivyo nipfuza?
Ariko abantu babi bazotabwa nk’amahwa, umuntu adashobora kwegeranya n’intoke gusa.
Uwukoze ku mahwa wese akoresha icuma canke uruti rw’icumu; maze agaturirirwa aho arunze.”
Aya ni yo mazina y’abahizi ba Dawidi: Yoshebu Bashebeti, Umutakemoni, yari umukuru wa bamwe batatu; yatoye icumu agwanya abantu amajana umunani, maze bose abicira icarimwe.

Yakurikirwa na Eliyazeri mwene Dodayi Umwahohi, yari umwe muri bamwe batatu b’abahizi mu ntambara, yari kumwe na Dawidi igihe bahagarara imbere y’Abafilisitiya bari batonze urugamba i Pasi-Damimu. Maze ingabo z’Abisirayeli zirahunga,

ariko we ararinda agwanya Abafilisitiya gushika aho ukuboko kugwa ibinyanya ku buryo atari agishobora kubangura inkota. Uhoraho atanga intsinzi ihambaye kuri uwo musi. Ingabo zahavuye zigaruka aho Eliyazeri ari, ariko bari baje gukoba imivyimba.
Uwa gatatu yari Shama mwene Ageyi Umuharari. Igihe Abafilisitiya bahurira hamwe mu murima wuzuye ibiharage, ingabo z’Abisirayeli zaciye zibahunga;
ariko Shama arabarinda ari hagati muri uwo murima. Arawugwanira maze yica Abafilisitiya, kandi Uhoraho atanga intsinzi ikomeye.
Mu gihe c’iyimbura, batatu bo mu bahizi biwe mirongo itatu baramanuka basanga Dawidi aho yari ari mw’isenga ry’ibuye i Adulamu. Ico gihe umugwi w’Abafilisitiya wari ucumbitse mu kiyaya c’i Refayimu.
Muri ico gihe Dawidi yari mu kinyegero, kandi umuce w’ingabo z’Abafilisitiya wari i Betelehemu.
Dawidi yumva agomba amazi, maze aca avuga ati: “Ese icompa hakagira uwunzanira amazi yo kunywa yo kw’iriba riri kw’irembo ry’i Betelehemu!”

Nuko ba bahizi batatu baragenda, baca hagati y’ingabo z’Abafilisitiya, bavoma ayo mazi yo kw’iriba ryari hafi y’irembo ry’i Betelehemu bayashira Dawidi. Ariko Dawidi yanka kuyanywa; ayasesa hasi imbere y’ Uhoraho .
Avuga ati: “Ntibikabe, ewe Uhoraho ko nokora ivyo! Nokwubahuka kunywa amaraso y’aba bantu bahevye amagara yabo?” Dawidi ntiyemera kuyanywa. Ivyo ni vyo vy’ubuhizi abo bagabo batatu bakoze.
Abishayi mwene nyina wa Yowabu mwene Zeruwiya yari umukuru w’abo batatu. Yishe abantu amajana atatu akoresheje icumu ryiwe, bituma aba rurangiranwa nka bamwe batatu.
Mbega ntiyabaye uw’icubahiro kurusha abo batatu? Mbere yabaye umutware wabo, naho atashizwe mu gitigiri cabo.

Benaya mwene Yehoyada yari umugwanyi w’umuhizi yava i Kabuzeyeli, kandi yakoze ibihambaye. Yishe abahizi babiri baruta abandi mu ngabo z’Abanyamowabu. Umusi umwe shelegi iriko iragwa, amanuka mu rwobo, yica intambwe.
Ni we yishe Umunyegiputa w’ikigatanya. Naho uwo Munyegiputa yari afise icumu mu minwe, Benaya yagiye kumugwanya afise inkoni, amushikura rya cumu mu minwe, aba ari ryo amwicisha.
Ivyo ni vyo bikorwa vy’ubuhizi Benaya mwene Yehoyada yakoze; na we nyene yari rurangiranwa nka bamwe batatu.
Yari afise icubahiro kuruta bamwe mirongo itatu, ariko ntiyari uwo muri bamwe batatu. Maze Dawidi aca amugira umukuru w’abacungera umutekano wiwe.
Muri abo mirongo itatu harimwo: Asaheli yavukana na Yowabu, Eluhanani mwene Dodo w’i Betelehemu,
Shama w’i Harodi, Elika w’i Harodi,
Helezi w’i Paluti, Ira mwene Ikeshi w’i Tekowa,
Abiyezeri w’i Anatoti, Mebunayi Umuhushati,
Zalumoni w’Umwahohi, Maharayi w’i Netofati
Heledi mwene Bayana w’i Netofati, Itayi mwene Ribayi w’i Gibeya mu Bubenyamini,
Benaya w’i Piratoni, Hidayi wo mu bihomoka vy’i Gayashi,
Abi-Aluboni Umwarubati, Azumaveti Umubahurimu,
Eliyaba Umushaluboni, Bene Yasheni, Yonatani
mwene Shama Umuharari, Ahiyamu mwene Sharari Umuharari,
Elifeleti mwene Ahasubayi w’i Mayaka, Eliyamu mwene Ahitofeli w’i Giloni,
Heziro w’i Karumeli, Payari w’i Arubi,
Igali mwene Natani w’i Zoba, Bani w’i Gadi,
Zeleki Umwamoni, Naharayi Umuberoti, uwatwaza Yowabu mwene Zeruwiya ibigwanisho,
Ira w’i Ituri, Garebu w’i Ituri
na Uriya Umuheti. Bose hamwe bari mirongo itatu n’indwi.
Maze uburake bw’ Uhoraho bwongera kuziriringira Abisirayeli, aca atera Dawidi agatima ko kubaharura kugira ngo abakwegere ivyago, avuga ati: “Genda uharure Abisirayeli n’Abayuda.”
Nuko umwami abwira Yowabu n’intwazangabo bari kumwe na we ati: “Nimukwiragire mu miryango yose y’Abisirayeli kuva i Dani gushika i Berisheba muharure abazi kugwana, kugira ngo menye uko bangana.”
Ariko Yowabu yishura umwami ati: “ Uhoraho Imana yawe arakagwiza ingabo incuro ijana, kandi inyonga z’umwami wanje zize zibibone. Ariko ni kubera iki umwami wanje ashaka gukora ikintu nk’ico?”
Ariko ijambo ry’umwami rirengera irya Yowabu, maze Yowabu n’intwazangabo bava imbere y’umwami, baja guharura ingabo z’Abisirayeli.
Bamaze kujabuka Yorodani, bacumbika i ruhande ya Aroweri, mu bumanuko bw’igisagara mu kabande, hanyuma baca mu ntara ya Gadi n’i Yazeri.
Baja i Gileyadi n’i Kadeshi mu ntara y’i Tahutimu Hodushi, bashishikara baja i Dani Yani berekeye i Sidoni.
Maze baca baja ku ruzitiro rw’i Tiro no mu bisagara vy’Abahiwi n’Abanyakanani. Barangije baja i Berisheba n’i Negebu i Buyuda.
Bamaze kunyuragira mu gihugu cose, bagaruka i Yerusalemu haheze amezi icenda n’imisi mirongo ibiri.
Yowabu ashikiriza umwami igitigiri c’abantu baja ku rugamba. Muri Isirayeli hari ibihumbi amajana umunani b’abahizi bazi kugwanisha inkota, mu Buyuda na ho ibihumbi amajana atanu.

Dawidi amaze guharura ingabo, umutima utangura kumurega, maze abwira Uhoraho ati: “Nacumuye cane kuko nakoze ivyo. None rero, Uhoraho , ndakwinginze, unkureko icaha canje jewe umusavyi wawe. Nakoze ivy’ubupfu.”
Dawidi avyutse mu gitondo ijambo ry’ Uhoraho riza kuri Gadi uwavugishwa na we akaba n’uwerekwa wa Dawidi ati:
“Genda ubwire Dawidi uti: ‘Uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze: Ndaguhaye ibintu bitatu. Hitamwo kimwe nzoguhanisha.’ ”

Nuko Gadi aja kwa Dawidi aramubwira ati: “Mbega yoguteza imyaka itatu y’inzara mu gihugu cawe, canke amezi atatu yo guhunga abansi banyu bariko barabakinagiza, canke imisi itatu y’ikiza mu gihugu canyu? Nuko rero nuvyiyumvireko, uhitemwo hanyuma umbwire, kugira ngo ngire ico nishura uwantumye.”
Dawidi abwira Gadi ati: “Ndi n’umubabaro mwinshi. Reka tugwe mu maboko y’ Uhoraho , kuko imbabazi ziwe ari nyinshi; ariko singwe mu maboko y’abantu.”
Nuko Uhoraho arungika ikiza mu Bisirayeli guhera muri ico gitondo gushika ico gihe cashinzwe giheze, maze hapfa abantu ibihumbi mirongo indwi kuva i Dani gushika i Berisheba.

Umumarayika agoroye ukuboko kwiwe ngo arandure Yerusalemu, Uhoraho ababazwa n’ico cago aca abwira uwo mumarayika yariko aratikiza abantu ati: “Geza aho! Garukana ukuboko kwawe!” Umumarayika w’ Uhoraho muri ico gihe yari ku mbuga yo kugosorerako ingano ya Arawuna Umuyebusi.
Dawidi abonye umumarayika yariko arica abantu, abwira Uhoraho ati: “Ni jewe nacumuye nkora icaha. Aba bantu bo ni nk’intama. None bakoze iki? Ukuboko kwawe niguhane jewe n’umuryango wanje.”
Kuri uwo musi Gadi aja kwa Dawidi aramubwira ati: “Duga wubakire Uhoraho igicaniro ku mbuga yo kugosorerako ingano ya Arawuna Umuyebusi.”
Nuko Dawidi araduga, nk’uko Uhoraho yari yamutegetse biciye kuri Gadi.
Maze Arawuna yunamuye amaso abona umwami n’abantu biwe baza aho ari, aca arunama imbere y’umwami, ashika hasi.

Maze Arawuna avuga ati: “Ni iki kizanye umwami wanje ku musavyi wiwe?” Dawidi amwishura ati: “Nzanywe no kugura imbuga yawe, kugira ngo ndahubakire Uhoraho igicaniro, kugira ngo ikiza kiri mu bantu gihagarare.”

Arawuna abwira Dawidi ati: “Umwami wanje niyakire ico yipfuza cose gushikana. Ng’izi n’impfizi z’ikimazi co guturirwa n’umuriro, kandi ehe n’imihini yo gusekura hamwe n’ingogo ndabitanze ngo bibe inkwi,
vyose ndabiguhaye, mwami.” Arawuna yongera abwira umwami ati: “ Uhoraho Imana yemere kwakira ikimazi cawe.”

Ariko umwami yishura Arawuna ati: “Oya, ndakwinginze unyemerere ndakurihe. Sinshobora gushikanira Uhoraho Imana yanje ikimazi ata co ndakiguze.” Nuko Dawidi agura iyo mbuga n’izo nka atanga, shekeli mirongo itanu z’ifeza.
Dawidi yubakira Uhoraho igicaniro aca atanga ibimazi vyo guturirwa n’ivy’ishimwe. Maze Uhoraho yishura isengesho ryiwe, ikiza kiva mu Bisirayeli.
